rites.name: Sinteornus
rites.text: A violent upward kick technique practiced by a fighter of a blade-dueling circle. It launches an opponent skyward during combat.

rites.name: Serausor
rites.text: A heavy stone technique in which a warrior slams a trapping blow sideways to crush the foe. It is one of the fighter's wide strikes used in combat.

rites.name: Valornanum
rites.text: A rising strike in which the fighter drives one leg upward in a fast sweeping motion. It is one of the eight-directional rushing kicks used by a swordsman.

rites.name: Nauliasus
rites.text: A combat maneuver performed by a brawler, in which a wave-like strike is immediately followed by a long horn-like thrust. It is one of the fighter's signature sequences in the arena.

rites.name: Contarnum
rites.text: A sweeping sideways strike delivered with an open hand, used as an attack by a masked fighter. It lashes out horizontally across the battlefield.

rites.name: Lyimeth
rites.text: Lyimeth is the concept of a steady root-song that runs beneath the soil of Morurnath, felt by the first sovereign as a pulse that tells seeds when to split. It has no body and no seat, only the rhythm by which groves learn to hold their ground.

rites.name: Drouktarnok
rites.text: Drouktarnok is the concept of the slow pull that draws roots downward and shapes the first groves of Morurnath during the Singing. It is less a force than a pattern of growth, felt in how seedlings lean toward water and how young kingdoms learn to bend around their forests.

rites.name: Thyusis
rites.text: Thyusis is the concept of a resonant tone that rings through Morurnath during the Singing, when the first roots of the world gather their shape out of sound. In the Age of Sundering it is said to have quickened when landfall broke the old bonds between shores, scattering its harmonics across newborn coasts.

rites.name: Seleornor
rites.text: A bodily technique in which a fighter drives forward and strikes an opponent with a kick. Some practitioners call it by a different name.

rites.name: Tireosanum
rites.text: A defensive technique that a fighter uses to raise a curtain of sharpened edges. It belongs to one warrior's repertoire in a sword duel.

rites.name: Nialeornum
rites.text: A brawler lifts a heavy stone-bodied fighter and hurls them across the arena. A wild warrior shares a similar throw, though it goes unnamed.

rites.name: Serasiantor
rites.text: A swift, forward-leaping strike used in combat by a warrior named for a praying insect. It first appears in an early duel-based fighting tradition and is performed by a single practitioner.

rites.name: Orantostia
rites.text: A devastating close-range maneuver in which a fighter drives a knee into an opponent's leg to break their stance. It is one of the attacks used by two combatants in a deadly duel.

rites.name: Ceonium
rites.text: A bodily technique in which a fighter lowers the frame and drives the shoulder forward into an opponent. It is paired with a sudden kick, and a warrior has used it since first entering the battle-rites.

rites.name: Rentallus
rites.text: A leaping strike used by a fighter who rises high into the air before crashing down. It is a technique practiced by warriors who fight with rock-like force.

rites.name: Amernanum
rites.text: A rising thrust that a dark reaper performs while lifting himself upward. It strikes straight from below toward the sky.

rites.name: Amosterium
rites.text: A sweeping strike delivered horizontally across the body, used as one of the fighter's standard combat moves. It is a technique practiced in close combat duels.

rites.name: Raroles
rites.text: A short striking technique used in close brawling. A fighter drives a foot forward to knock an opponent off balance.

rites.name: Valerum
rites.text: A leaping strike that a pair of warriors perform by springing into the air and driving a foot forward. Two other fighters use a similar motion that looks much the same.

rites.name: Nollauranum
rites.text: A horizontal strike used by a brawler who adopted it after an older swinging technique was dropped. It is a sweeping blow that replaces a previous attack in his repertoire.

rites.name: Coreontes
rites.text: A fighter's rearward kick used in close combat. It belongs to one warrior's repertoire of strikes and is performed as part of a set of kick attacks.

rites.name: Orialus
rites.text: A heavy overhead strike in which the fighter lifts a massive weight and hurls it downward onto the foe. It appears in later combat styles of the arena duel.

rites.name: Veostantia
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike performed by a wandering duelist, favored since their first appearance in combat. It is a signature movement that marks the fighter's style.

rites.name: Amilornum
rites.text: A counterstrike technique that a fighter can unleash while holding a defensive stance. It takes the place of an older sweeping kick from earlier training methods.

rites.name: Ventor
rites.text: A rising strike delivered with a forward-driven shoulder and boot, used by fighters who favor a sudden, close-range rush.

rites.name: Teliastor
rites.text: A kick technique that several dark fighters use to strike from an unseen angle. It belongs to the repertoire of a few brutal warriors.

rites.name: Ristium
rites.text: A swift sideways strike delivered with the leg, used as one of the fighter's kicking techniques in a duel. Later practitioners favor a straighter forward thrust instead.

rites.name: Serausanum
rites.text: A low sweeping strike with the leg that a fighter has known since first entering the arena. A wild warrior from another duel also uses it, though that one carries no name.

rites.name: Tauntum Valeostanum
rites.text: A fighting technique passed among warriors of a desert sect, drawn from a stance that drives a sudden forward thrust. Several rival fighters in the wider contest of champions have adopted it as part of their repertoire.

rites.name: Amauntus
rites.text: A straight forward jab used by fighters of the warrior clans, aimed at the chest of an opponent. It is passed down among a few practitioners who train with the long blade.

rites.name: Larontor
rites.text: A fighter's crashing technique that delivers a heavy, pouncing strike. Practitioners use it as a signature move for overwhelming opponents.

rites.name: Raulles
rites.text: A swirling horizontal blow that a fighter unleashes in a duel, sweeping across the foe with a rush of wind-like force.

rites.name: Oraullor
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior rises through a spiraling upward strike. A common brute with scaled hide also knows this maneuver.

rites.name: Coreolines
rites.text: A heavy arc-strike used by a fighter, sweeping a great blade in a wide swing. It is known under a second, harsher name in some regional tellings.

rites.name: Caneres
rites.text: A swift looping leg technique practiced by duelists of the old blade schools. It is a kick that spins the body around and strikes an opponent who has closed in.

rites.name: Seraustanum
rites.text: A bracing strike delivered by a fighter's forward striking limb, rolling into a sweeping arc that lands with a heavy, horizontal force. It is one of several sideways blows a skilled combatant can unleash.

rites.name: Vaureollum
rites.text: A grappling maneuver performed by fighters who stand behind a foe, seizing them from the rear. It first appeared in an early bout of ritual combat and was later swapped for a similar hold.

rites.name: Valeosor
rites.text: A heavy vertical strike used by a brawler, which takes the place of an older lunging blow once favored in earlier duels.

rites.name: Halurnath
rites.text: Halurnath is a grounded concept from Morurnath's second era, a rhythmic sequence of strikes that builds into a final cascade of blades. Its wielder moves like a tide, each flourish drawing a little more of the surrounding stone into its arc.

rites.name: Thyuvsith
rites.text: Thyuvsith is a concept in Morurnath, a grounded realm where the Courts hold divine trials and the doors between worlds are slowly built by councils of the wise. Its essence is the patient binding of a threshold, measured more in persuasion and stone than in raw force.

rites.name: Orienuarlys
rites.text: Orienuarlys is the concept of the bond between a grove and the hearth that tends it, understood in Morurnath as the quiet work by which a kingdom's roots learn to hold its walls. In the Courts of the second age, it was invoked whenever a council sought to settle who owed labor to whom. Its power is measured in rooted patience rather than spectacle.

rites.name: Halurdock
rites.text: Halurdock is a concept of the Courts in Morurnath, the principle that a trial is won by whoever keeps the most careful count of their own debts. It was set down in the early Holy Age, when flame-temples first argued over who should judge the doors between worlds. Its influence lingers mainly as a rule of conduct among the orders.

rites.name: Sileinneth
rites.text: Sileinneth is a concept of Morurnath, the thread-sense that the Courts used to measure whether a bond between two places still held. In the Age of Sundering, it was the quiet force that taught the builders where a door could be set without tearing the land on either side.

rites.name: Amilianus
rites.text: A downward combat technique used by a swordsman to hack at an opponent from above. It belongs to a family of strikes that travel vertically through the target's guard.

rites.name: Launtia
rites.text: A low horizontal strike performed from a standing position, used by a dark armored warrior as one of his sweeping blade maneuvers. It targets an opponent's legs and lower body.

rites.name: Sentia
rites.text: A downward strike in which a warrior hurls their weapon from overhead to crash onto a foe. Several fearsome combatants are known to use it.

rites.name: Ceores
rites.text: A downward thrust used by a single warrior, and a few lesser fighters are also said to perform it, though they never name it. It is a strike that drops straight from above.

rites.name: Coriantanum
rites.text: A low, sudden strike performed by a wandering duelist, a foot lashing out from a crouch. The technique has been practiced by the same fighter since their first appearance in a clash of blades.

rites.name: Rostum
rites.text: A swift eight-stroke sequence of running kicks used mainly by one fighter. Other warriors in later eras learn and perform the same technique.

rites.name: Soneontus
rites.text: A dark ember-art that follows a lesser sweeping technique, wielded by three rival practitioners. It is said to be the next step after an older soul-erasing craft.

rites.name: Corilastum
rites.text: A dark miasma that a monstrous wielder releases as a sweeping horizontal strike. It is a technique used by a fearsome fighter with a warped and corrupted body.

rites.name: Tiales
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike performed by two wielders while they are bound into a shared trance stance. The blow moves through the air as a rushing gust of force.

rites.name: Mistium
rites.text: A swift sequence of eight kicks delivered by a fighter who strikes while turned away from the foe. It is a hidden technique a combatant can unleash from a reversed stance.

rites.name: Oriasanum
rites.text: A downward strike used by several warriors and demons. Certain fighters borrow its motion, and one variant launches a sweep of flame across the battlefield.

rites.name: Neontia
rites.text: A fighter's unblockable strike that cannot be guarded against. It is known by a different name in some regions.

rites.name: Niasontor
rites.text: A sweeping strike delivered sideways through the air by a warrior who has carried the technique since first entering the arena. It is one of her long-standing moves.

rites.name: Meostaulor
rites.text: A forward strike delivered with the leg, used by two fighters of the same discipline. It works as a shared technique passed among practitioners.

rites.name: Oraulleorum
rites.text: A deceptive maneuver in which a fighter feigns a reckless leap toward ruin, only to twist back and strike. It has long been part of one warrior's repertoire since his first appearance in a blade duel.

rites.name: Marnum
rites.text: A descending technique that a warrior performs while hovering aloft. It lets the fighter drop sharply from the air to strike an opponent below.

rites.name: Seriallum Valiastes
rites.text: A celestial spirit-technique that a dark reaper and his shadow use to leap through the air and strike. It belongs to their set of airborne assaults.

rites.name: Orintia
rites.text: A sweeping strike wielded by a warrior that sweeps across the battlefield horizontally. When the wielder is empowered, the strike can end with a shift into a dark mounted form.

rites.name: Lilor
rites.text: A swift lunging strike used by a wandering blade-bearer in mid-run. The move is borrowed from an older tradition of running attacks passed between distant schools.

rites.name: Riseornium
rites.text: A low, sweeping strike used by a dancer-warrior who has fought with it for years. It travels across the ground to strike opponents close to the floor.

rites.name: Rerium
rites.text: A fighter's rearward kick that sends the opponent's head snapping backward. It is one of the blows a certain duelist of a distant order uses in close combat.

rites.name: Orolintum
rites.text: A low, sliding horizontal strike used by a wielder to open a clash. It is one of the fighter's standard sweeping cuts.

rites.name: Sialleontia
rites.text: A counter-striking technique that a fighter has held since a certain tournament era. It turns an opponent's blow back against them.

rites.name: Rostia
rites.text: A sweeping gathering strike performed by a wielder whose blade lies coiled and waiting. It sweeps horizontally across the battlefield to catch foes in its arc.

rites.name: Maures
rites.text: A reversal technique held by a shadow warrior that turns an incoming foot strike back on the attacker. It only answers certain kicks, and against any other kick the warrior switches to a different counter.

rites.name: Ciaraules
rites.text: A fighter's rearward flip that ends in a kick, performed only while the wielder holds a mirrored guarding posture. It is a technique used in a single duelling arena.

rites.name: Niantia Nilaunium
rites.text: A flat, sideways strike used by a wandering fighter in a sparring tradition. It is a later version of an older, identical stroke that the same fighter once carried.

rites.name: Naliarnes
rites.text: A ritual strike performed by a sorcerer-warrior while empowered by spirit energy. It sweeps through the air horizontally against a single opponent.

rites.name: Amiases
rites.text: A rising sweeping strike performed from a low stance, sending the wielder's blade upward through an opponent's guard. It is a standard technique of a fierce duelist's repertoire.

rites.name: Oriseontum
rites.text: A low, sweeping strike used in a sword duel. It belongs to a fighter's set of horizontal attacks and is performed with a blade drawn across the body.

rites.name: Amollum
rites.text: A forceful leg technique performed by a fighter named after a sovereign scholar. It rises from a grounded stance to deliver a crushing blow.

rites.name: Telanium
rites.text: A deadly strike that a few fighters unleash by crossing their blades in a sweeping motion. Several bearers of a cursed sword have mastered this technique.

rites.name: Lasus
rites.text: A fighter spins a flaming blade sideways in a sweeping arc, a technique passed down among wandering monks. It is often named after the tail of a rebirth bird.

rites.name: Valenum
rites.text: A practiced throw performed by a fighter who stands behind an opponent, used by several named combatants. It relies on positioning rather than force.

rites.name: Senia
rites.text: A battle maneuver used by a fighter in a combat tradition, which is later superseded by a newer technique of the same kind. It is one of the attacks a warrior of this practice can perform.

rites.name: Cinanum
rites.text: A sideways blow delivered with a round guard, typically used by one warrior of a sword-bearing order. It can be followed by a strike from the sword's pommel.

rites.name: Serestum
rites.text: A deceptive fighting technique in which the wielder fakes a blow to draw a guard open. It is later superseded by a more rhythmic sequence of movements.

rites.name: Oriantastus
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike used by two warriors of a sacred order. A wandering assassin also wields a version of it, though he never gives it a name.

rites.name: Valontistor
rites.text: A sweeping foot strike used by a practitioner of an ancient duelling art. In a later revision of the training forms, a different sequence takes its place.

rites.name: Telisia
rites.text: A technique that a wielder may perform only while a sphere rests in its set place. When the sphere is carried instead, the wielder performs a different technique.

rites.name: Vosernum
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike used by a warrior of the fighting arts. It is a looping blow that gathers momentum and releases it across a wide arc.

rites.name: Telornor
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a warrior in close combat, seizing an opponent and hurling them down. It first appeared in the later chapters of a famous sword-fighting tale.

rites.name: Sernium
rites.text: A combat technique used by a wandering warrior to strike at an opponent's upper body. It is practiced by fighters who favor swift, staff-like movements.

rites.name: Teoniasum
rites.text: An ancient self-defense craft that began in early history, inspired by a philosophy of flowing circles of energy. It was carried to distant lands and later renamed as a general art of combat.

rites.name: Vinentes
rites.text: A leaping sideways strike performed by a sword-bearing warrior. It looks almost exactly like a related leap, differing only in a slightly lower angle of the blade.

rites.name: Canor
rites.text: A horizontal strike performed by a fighter who stands with her back turned toward the opponent. It is a sweeping technique delivered from that rearward-facing stance.

rites.name: Serialus
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike used by three fighters, one of whom later trades it for a different blow. Another warrior eventually receives a new strike that replaces it.

rites.name: Seraures
rites.text: A variant of a serpent-breath technique that its wielder can use in combat. It is drawn from a sweeping, sea-cutting motion.

rites.name: Vinarnus
rites.text: A coiled strike learned by wandering duelists who rise from a crouch with a sudden lunge. Its practitioners are taught to bite the air at the last moment of the motion.

rites.name: Vaullor
rites.text: A fluid strike technique performed by two different wielders, each using a distinct regional name for it. It is a flourishing move that rises from the ground in a sweeping arc.

rites.name: Telornanum
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter steps to the side of an opponent, hoists them onto the shoulders, and hurls them down. It is used only when the attacker stands on the opponent's left.

rites.name: Tiania
rites.text: A kicking technique used by two fighters to drive away their opponent. It is also known by a second name meaning expulsion.

rites.name: Sinestum
rites.text: A sweeping strike drawn across a wide arc in eight directions by two wielders of the order. It was devised to take the place of an older, sharper technique.

rites.name: Riantonium
rites.text: A nearly unstoppable flurry of crimson strikes that a warrior unleashes after a self-inflicted sacrifice. It cannot be guarded against once begun.

rites.name: Naulleoses
rites.text: A coiling grappling maneuver practiced by a particular fighting order, in which the performer wraps around an opponent. Lesser scaled brawlers have also adopted the same technique.

rites.name: Telianes
rites.text: A ten-stroke sequence of rapid blows performed by a warrior of the wilds. It is the second of his chained technique forms and ends in a decisive finish.

rites.name: Tasium
rites.text: A dim follow-up technique that a warrior can use in an ancient blade duel. It builds directly on an earlier mirrored-shadow move.

rites.name: Coreonia
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a practitioner launches a sudden hidden assault after first completing a lesser preparatory strike. It belongs to a student's repertoire and is performed in sequence.

rites.name: Lontus
rites.text: A paired double-press technique used by a swordsman in a dueling tradition, delivered by striking two controls at once to spare the opponent. It is recognized as a signature move of a warrior from a northern order.

rites.name: Vostum
rites.text: A spinning leg technique performed by a scaled warrior and common reptilian fighters. It delivers a rising kick that whirls the body through the air.

rites.name: Ciasollanum
rites.text: A horizontal technique used by a sword-wielding duelist in the Ashen Circle tradition. It is a sweeping strike that sends the blade around in a wide arc.

rites.name: Sereostium Seontia
rites.text: A silent footwork posture practiced by three warrior women, sometimes known by a plainer name in other tongues. It lets them move with a hushed, gliding grace in combat.

rites.name: Nollaunium
rites.text: A swift, vertical striking technique used by a skilled warrior, rising and descending like a bolt from the sky. It belongs to the wielder's vertical attack repertoire.

rites.name: Serentus
rites.text: A furious earth-spirit technique unleashed by a wielder in combat. It was first recorded in the later chronicles of a dueling tradition.

rites.name: Serisum Amaurilum
rites.text: A warrior's technique that is unleashed when the strike buttons are held down, taking the place of a fiery blade art. It belongs to a single fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Sinium
rites.text: A ringed weapon-technique that a wielder may unleash only while their inner spirit is not roused. It is one of the decisive finishing maneuvers available to a single fighter in duels.

rites.name: Orianes
rites.text: A downward striking technique performed by a fighter with a warrior's blade. It is a single vertical blow that the same practitioner has used since first appearing in the old arena contests.

rites.name: Sirneosum
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which a combatant pulls away while driving a forward stab, keeping distance from the foe. It has been known to the practitioners of an old duelling school for generations.

rites.name: Ameollium
rites.text: A flat sideways blow used by a wielder of the blade arts. It cuts across the body of an opponent in one fluid motion.

rites.name: Serasor
rites.text: A sideways, sweeping blow favored by three rival duelists of the old orders. Earlier schools of combat knew it by a harsher name.

rites.name: Laleoria
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which the warrior spins backward beneath the sky's light and strikes the foe with a rising, shark-like rush. It is known among those who study combat as a reversed sweep.

rites.name: Tiarornanum
rites.text: A fighter swings a long blade upward in a sweeping arc, then follows with a downward overhead cut. It is one of the vertical strikes in her fighting style.

rites.name: Amorneostes
rites.text: A sweeping low kick used by two fighters in a temple-trained style. It appears in every bout where those two warriors take the field.

rites.name: Veornillia
rites.text: A rising kick technique wielded by a temple warrior in the arena of blades. It can be followed by a spinning storm strike.

rites.name: Colarnum
rites.text: A downward strike performed with a weapon by a skilled fighter. It is one of the attack forms taught within a warrior's training.

rites.name: Seriales
rites.text: A low sweeping strike performed while crouching with one's back turned toward the foe. It skims across the ground to catch an opponent who is not expecting it.

rites.name: Ranauntium
rites.text: A sweeping low strike performed by a wandering swordsman during duels. It sends a foe staggering with a quick, sharp sideways motion of the leg.

rites.name: Telornes
rites.text: A throwing technique used by a fighter who faces the left side of an opponent. It is performed by several practitioners of the order when they approach from that angle.

rites.name: Rinteostium
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike that a fighter unleashes in close combat. It is one of the signature moves of a dark, hollow-eyed warrior from a sword-fighting tradition.

rites.name: Telistum
rites.text: A downward striking maneuver favored by two wandering fighters. It is performed as a vertical strike that cuts straight down through an opponent's guard.

rites.name: Coriastor Rialor
rites.text: A practitioner brings a heavy overhead blow downward in a single vertical motion. This strike took the place of an older paired-hammer technique in later duels.

rites.name: Serellisium
rites.text: A leaping, unstoppable maneuver used by a wandering swordsman against foes. It cannot be defended once the leap begins.

rites.name: Narium
rites.text: A ten-strike sequence of quick blows performed by a single fighter. It is one of the striking techniques of a particular warrior, known for its rapid chain of hits.

rites.name: Tianium
rites.text: A downward combat maneuver performed by a duelist, which begins with a hilt-driven blow and is followed by a rising sweep of the blade.

rites.name: Valarnerus
rites.text: A fighter's striking technique that drives a leg upward toward an opponent. It is one of the kick maneuvers available to a warrior in a dueling tradition.

rites.name: Tostaulus
rites.text: A sweeping sideways strike that a wielder performs while turned away from a foe. It is a technique passed down among a lone duelist's kin.

rites.name: Valaulus
rites.text: A rising sideways strike performed by a heavy-weapon wielder as they climb upward. It took over from an older swinging blow the same fighter once used.

rites.name: Valeolinor
rites.text: A horizontal backward swing used by a masked duelist, carried out with the arm turned outward. It is one of the fighter's sideways attacks.

rites.name: Sauneorium
rites.text: A grappling maneuver used by a desert warrior, in which the attacker seizes a foe and forces them down into shifting grains. It is also learned by a common scaled brute.

rites.name: Castinus
rites.text: A fighter's backward-spinning kick used in close combat, drawn from the repertoire of a warrior's trained fighting style. It turns a retreating motion into a surprising counterattack.

rites.name: Cestium
rites.text: A fighting posture held by an armored warrior, used as a ready position for defense. It is recognized as a longstanding practice in the discipline.

rites.name: Amiases Amirallanum
rites.text: A chained sequence of kicks performed by a fighter with a staff-like weapon. It is used as an attack by one particular warrior in the combat style.

rites.name: Nianausor
rites.text: A horizontal blow delivered while the fighter rises from a crouch. Its quiet arc is known to several warriors who practise the same rising sweep.

rites.name: Nirosus
rites.text: A low, sweeping strike used in a duelist's combat style, where the fighter drives a heavy foot down through an opponent's guard. It was first taught to warriors in a later age.

rites.name: Ventum
rites.text: A forceful technique that only one blade-wielding warrior can perform. It appears exclusively in a single cursed weapon's lore and belongs to a fighter who wields a twin-bladed style.

rites.name: Mistosia
rites.text: A rising kick used from a crane-like guard posture by a fighter. When it strikes an opponent in the air, it transitions into a seizing throw that can be countered with a precisely timed press.

rites.name: Orintus
rites.text: A stance adopted by a sword-bearer in a duel of blades. It closely resembles another of her movements, a ritual shift of footing used to move the body.

rites.name: Oristanum
rites.text: A sideways strike that follows a ghostly gust with a second swift blow from a masked warrior. Later, a bolder flashing finisher takes its place in the practice of the blade.

rites.name: Nianeostium
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike that a fighter unleashes while turned away from the foe, performed only from a standing stance. Two warriors among the ancient orders are known to wield it.

rites.name: Ventus
rites.text: A low, sideways leg technique used by a wrestler-brawler, first taught in his early training. Later refinements let him follow it with grappling holds.

rites.name: Miaror
rites.text: A ritual strike unleashed by a fire-bearer while holding a starborn posture. It lets the caster deliver a burst of scorching ruin in that stance.

rites.name: Viarellor
rites.text: A fighter's sudden leaping strike performed during a silent stance. It is one of several moves available from that quiet footwork.

rites.name: Oreontauria
rites.text: A ferocious strike practiced by three duelists that becomes a grappling throw when the foe is knocked to the ground. Landing it leaves the wielder swelling with a dreadful rage.

rites.name: Tosum
rites.text: A combined maneuver in which a fiery sweep of the staff is immediately followed by a driving thrust. It belongs to a single wielder's fighting repertoire.

rites.name: Rastia Linus
rites.text: A follow-up strike that a fighter unleashes right after a heavy opening blow, delivered from above. It has appeared in only a couple of older combat titles.

rites.name: Ameontesus
rites.text: A fighter's eight-directional rising strike, performed in a sweeping run that cuts upward across the body. It belongs to a single warrior's repertoire of combat moves.

rites.name: Renanum
rites.text: A savage grappling strike used by three dread wielders of shadow and flame. It is delivered as an attack throw and is favored by those who fight with fearsome, nightmarish force.

rites.name: Valeosus
rites.text: A sweeping kick that strikes a foe lying on the ground and, if it lands, drags them into a forceful throw. It is a signature move of a skilled blade-bearing warrior.

rites.name: Riallesus
rites.text: A sweeping sideways blow carried out by a warrior of the temple blade-arts. It takes the breath from opponents who face it.

rites.name: Sereollia Ameostes
rites.text: A fighter's kick launched from a misty guard posture, striking an opponent with a sudden rising burst. It is one of the techniques a warrior can perform while shrouded in fog.

rites.name: Valornanum Loreosanum
rites.text: A devastating technique wielded by a fighter who channels the earth's violent tremors into a single crushing strike. It is one of the signature moves of a relentless, shadowy warrior.

rites.name: Leonanum Valania
rites.text: A swift forward-dashing maneuver that a warrior can perform while holding a possessed stance. It lets the fighter advance across the field during that posture.

rites.name: Sorum
rites.text: A sacred rite that turns a strike into a binding curse upon the foe. When struck, the rite shifts into a seizing throw that marks the victim with a lingering doom.

rites.name: Serentia
rites.text: A horizontal strike performed by a wielder who steps forward into the opening. It belongs to a set of sweeping blows used by a single fighter in close combat.

rites.name: Laulanes
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike used by two fighters of a rival school. It cuts across the foe's line in a single arc.

rites.name: Amauntium
rites.text: A low, sweeping sidestep technique that a swordsman performs while holding a half-moon stance. It is used as a horizontal slash from within that guarded posture.

rites.name: Oraures Sianerus
rites.text: A horizontal strike used by a swordsman in a duel. It sweeps across the body in a single flowing motion, and it is known under a second name in another region.

rites.name: Sellantus
rites.text: A maneuver in which a fighter stands behind an opponent and hurls them forward. It is performed by a practitioner who has mastered positioning at the rear of a rival.

rites.name: Valereosum
rites.text: A throwing technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent and hurls them with a crushing carnival-style flourish. It is practiced by a warrior and a fiend in a sword-dueling tradition.

rites.name: Amesaullus
rites.text: A devastating technique wielded by a warrior that cannot be blocked. It replaces an older strike the warrior once relied upon in an earlier struggle.

rites.name: Reonastia
rites.text: A combat maneuver used by a wandering duelist, following an opening slash with a second, sweeping thrust. It is a sequence of blade technique passed down among warriors.

rites.name: Caullor
rites.text: A vertical strike from a bladed-wielder's repertoire, used in a close combat art. It is one of the attacks that a fighter can deliver from above.

rites.name: Corosum
rites.text: A sliding strike performed by a fighter in a duel, replacing an older thrusting technique once taught in earlier training. It moves low across the ground toward an opponent.

rites.name: Orolum
rites.text: A low leg-sweep technique practiced by a wandering blade-monk who spins on one heel to topple foes. Later schools of the same discipline refine it into a faster, arcing variant.

rites.name: Ameolor
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter unleashes a rapid flurry of thrusts that keep striking the foe. A later, sharper form of the same technique is also known to practitioners.

rites.name: Coroleosium
rites.text: A wide sideways strike used by a heavy fighter in duels. It sends a rushing arc across the battlefield, forcing rivals to leap or fall back.

rites.name: Linauror
rites.text: A sweeping sideways strike performed with paired curved reapers wielded by a single fighter. In a later revised version, the move is replaced by a chained variant.

rites.name: Orintus Laulum
rites.text: A fighter's bold technique drawn from an inner reserve of determination, unleashed during a sacred trial of strength. It is a signature move of a master duelist.

rites.name: Rises
rites.text: A high-kicking striking technique used in close combat by a fighter with a blade-based style. It targets the upper leg of an opponent to break their balance.

rites.name: Niallastor
rites.text: A ritual strike that rises upward in a fierce sweep, used by a shadowy warrior in dueling halls. It belongs to a practitioner's stock of vertical assaults.

rites.name: Viarasus
rites.text: A low horizontal sweeping technique performed by a swordsman, drawn from a quick, sideways arc of the blade. It is one of several strikes in his repertoire that cut across the body.

rites.name: Amenaullus
rites.text: A fighter's technique used while holding the mist posture, a strike that cuts through the flow of a stance. It belongs to a single wielder's repertoire of attacks.

rites.name: Vernaustium
rites.text: A rolling gust technique that a pair of wandering sky-dancers unleash while spinning in a whirl of air. It is one of several strikes the duo can draw on during that spinning dance.

rites.name: Vonaulium
rites.text: A bearer's spirit-strike that is unleashed from a defensive stance. A second form of the same strike can be called upon while holding a guarded posture.

rites.name: Leornanum
rites.text: A low, sweeping kick used by a swordsman that catches an opponent's legs and turns the fight. It is a technique taught within a fighting discipline.

rites.name: Sialeostium
rites.text: A grappling throw practiced by a warrior-mother and later taught to her daughter. It is passed down through generations of fighters in a single family line.

rites.name: Corausoria
rites.text: A fighter's rushing hurl that seizes an opponent and drives them to the ground. It is a grappling technique used in close combat.

rites.name: Coronium Nasus
rites.text: A tempest-bound maneuver used by a wandering trainee in combat. It unleashes a violent burst of gathered storm energy against an opponent.

rites.name: Valaurnum
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike performed by a fighter in a duel. It cuts through an opponent's guard with a wide arc of the blade.

rites.name: Seolliranum
rites.text: A downward strike performed with a blade, recorded as one of the vertical attacks of a fighter. It is known by a second, alternate name.

rites.name: Mintes
rites.text: A practitioner's sweeping leg technique that spins the body low to the ground and strikes an opponent's legs. It is one of the kicks used in a duelist's fighting style.

rites.name: Malinus
rites.text: A downward striking technique performed by a fighter whose back is turned toward the opponent while standing. It is the vertical attack used by a particular practitioner in that stance.

rites.name: Serillium
rites.text: A ritual technique that a sorceress can perform only when her sacred sphere is fixed in its proper resting place. If she carries the sphere instead, she performs a different rite.

rites.name: Tiastus
rites.text: A maneuver a cloaked sorceress performs only when her sphere rests fixed in its place. If she carries the sphere, she performs a different maneuver instead.

rites.name: Serolastia
rites.text: A fighter's vertical strike that cuts downward in a rolling arc. It is one of the fighter's standard attacks.

rites.name: Telarnus
rites.text: A sweeping low-to-high leg strike favored by a veteran fighter in a dueling hall. It is used as a horizontal attack, striking across the opponent's midsection with a rising sweep.

rites.name: Talor
rites.text: A grappling technique that a pair of warriors can perform on a foe. It hurls the opponent through the air during a close-quarters clash.

rites.name: Ilyamuariel
rites.text: Ilyamuariel is a concept held in Morurnath's Seeding, when makers plant the Weave and quiet powers lie dormant among the growing groves. It names the principle by which a sovereign's seed-keeping steadies young kingdoms against floods and blight.

rites.name: Veostiasia
rites.text: Veostiasia is a concept of the Weave, the planted lattice of quiet powers that the makers set into Morurnath during the Seeding of the Holy Age. It names the moment a temple's flame is kindled to hold the Weave still, and the order that tends it.

rites.name: Seonum
rites.text: A piercing mental attack wielded during a balanced harmony of forces. Its wielder uses it to strike at the foe's deeper convictions.

rites.name: Serostium
rites.text: A deceitful assault unleashed by a cloaked warrior in a duel. If the attacker is fully empowered, the strike ends with a shift into a dark mounted form.

rites.name: Nirnosor
rites.text: A dark strike that a warrior can unleash while standing in a shadowed stance. It is available only to certain blades and their wielders.

rites.name: Ceolor
rites.text: An unstoppable variant of a rising strike, wielded by a dark champion whose blade cannot be parried. It is a technique that shatters every defense it meets.

rites.name: Cernanum
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal blow delivered by a ghostly attendant of the underworld, who uses a curved claw to cut across an opponent. It is a technique rather than a weapon, performed by a single character in a dueling tradition.

rites.name: Nasillus
rites.text: A dark throwing technique used by a fiendish warrior in a sword duel. It flings an opponent through the air with a cursed force.

rites.name: Telinarnus
rites.text: A ritual strike wielded by two rival figures, drawing on a longing for a legendary champion's power. It is used as an attack in combat.

rites.name: Seriastanum
rites.text: A binding maneuver used in close combat, where a fighter's lashing strands seize an opponent and hold them in place. It is one of the forceful techniques a particular combatant commands.

rites.name: Serneonum
rites.text: A wielder adopts a possessed bodily stance and releases a sweeping gust-driven strike. It is a technique available to one practitioner while in that particular trance-like posture.

rites.name: Tiallanum
rites.text: A sudden strike that a mind-warrior unleashes while adopting a deceptive, mocking stance. It turns the opponent's own movements against them.

rites.name: Tiasum
rites.text: A ranged strike that a warrior can unleash while holding a particular fighting posture. It is an attack used in a single stance.

rites.name: Seraures Orinelles
rites.text: A sealed rolled parchment that a wielder can invoke while in a possessed stance, releasing a sudden offensive blast. It is one of the attacks available to its bearer in that trance.

rites.name: Amiaristium
rites.text: A defensive technique that a fighter uses to deflect incoming blows and turn the attack back against the opponent. It took the place of an older ritual gesture once used in combat.

rites.name: Coraunia
rites.text: A fighting technique where a warrior charges their spirit, then follows a forceful strike with a swift, swirling kick. It can only be unleashed while the spirit is fully roused.

rites.name: Cantausium
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which a fighter first scatters a handful of gleaming trinkets to draw the eye, then follows with a sweeping strike from a sacred sanctuary stance. It is a horizontal technique.

rites.name: Taullirnes
rites.text: A heightened form of a warrior's rage that a fighter can unleash once a special severing technique has been activated. It is channeled through the same practitioner who wields that technique.

rites.name: Mintaulum
rites.text: A paired strike performed by pressing two controls at the same moment, which finishes an opponent with a sharp, icy cut. Its alternate name is used in some regional releases of its tradition.

rites.name: Telisum
rites.text: A defenseless state that strikes a foe whose vital gauge flashes red after a heavy blow is stopped. The weakened fighter can suffer a decisive finishing strike, and their gauge cracks and drains faster.

rites.name: Rerum
rites.text: A bodily stance held by two combatants in the same tradition. It was first seen in an earlier duel of blades.

rites.name: Telonor
rites.text: A fierce power that a warrior can unleash only when their spirit is fully charged. It serves as a follow-up technique to an earlier blade maneuver.

rites.name: Reontanum
rites.text: A rising sweep technique that a fighter follows with a spinning strike after an uppercut. Several warriors have adopted it as a signature combination.

rites.name: Leres
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike wielded by a masked duelist, linked chains whipping a crescent blade around in a wide arc. Later duelists replace it with a sharper cutting technique.

rites.name: Valeostum
rites.text: A fighter's chain of eight rapid kicks in a single running sequence. It is one of the striking techniques of a sword duelist's repertoire in the arena.

rites.name: Ameronor
rites.text: A fighter's rapid strike of the leg that follows an earlier kick. A similar technique is known among a rival duelist's school, though it has no name.

rites.name: Rarneolia
rites.text: A fluid spinning strike performed with the legs, used by certain fighters as one of their kicking techniques. It is known under a second name in a rival tradition of combat.

rites.name: Tistanum
rites.text: A horizontal burst of stored energy that sweeps across a battlefield. Wielders of cursed blades draw on it to strike foes in a single line.

rites.name: Ameollor
rites.text: A rapid, relentless combat technique in which a fighter unleashes a flurry of forceful blows. It has been passed between several warriors across different versions of a famous duel.

rites.name: Amisanum
rites.text: A swift technique in which a fighter races along the ground, striking in eight directions. It was later superseded by a sharper blade maneuver.

rites.name: Viarus
rites.text: A harsher, more forceful form of a basic cutting technique. It is the stronger variant of a lighter slash, wielded by a figure who favors brutal strikes.

rites.name: Torenum
rites.text: A low sweeping strike performed by a warrior, used in combat to knock an opponent's footing away. It is a kick-based technique within a larger fighting art.

rites.name: Amintanum
rites.text: A sweeping low-to-the-ground strike used in close combat, drawn from a dark-aligned warrior's arsenal. It forces opponents to leap or crouch to avoid being struck.

rites.name: Oraullirum
rites.text: A sweeping eight-strike sequence of horizontal blows that a wandering duelist can unleash across the battlefield. A later style of technique eventually takes its place.

rites.name: Niaror
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder swiftly alters the configuration of a bladed weapon mid-combat. The maneuver lets the blade take on different forms on the fly.

rites.name: Moseornium
rites.text: A tactic that lets a brawler break from one grappling hold into a second throw of their choosing. Two different follow-up throws give the fighter a mix of options that no other fighter can use.

rites.name: Raustillium
rites.text: A fighter's eight-strike rushing assault that a dark-blade warrior unleashes in a rival duel. Each blow follows the last in a relentless chain.

rites.name: Serintarnes
rites.text: A short-range strike aimed at the midsection, used by several fighters of a duelist circle. Later fighters swap it for a sharper bird-like kick or a spinning variant.

rites.name: Veostor
rites.text: A technique that cannot be blocked, performed by a single martial master in a combat contest. It belongs to one fighter's repertoire of close-quarters skills.

rites.name: Rasaurnes
rites.text: A spinning strike practiced by two fighters in the arena. Its sweeping motion is shared with a silent technique used by a shadowy killer from an older duel.

rites.name: Telauronium
rites.text: A grappling technique used by a warrior to seize a foe as they break from a guarded posture. In later forms it strikes only when the attacker catches an opponent off guard.

rites.name: Launanum
rites.text: A strike that, once it connects, locks both combatants into a forced chain of blows where neither can steer or shield themselves. It is forceful yet hard to perform, and it still breaks when met by a stalling parry.

rites.name: Costeorium
rites.text: A variant of a trance-like fighting technique that a duelist can perform while turned away from the foe. It belongs to a trained combat style.

rites.name: Nauriales
rites.text: A horizontal strike used by a wandering blade-dancer who gained it through years of practice. It sweeps across the body of an opponent in a single motion.

rites.name: Serianes
rites.text: A low kick delivered from a crouch while the user turns their back toward the opponent. It is a fighting technique wielded by a skilled duelist.

rites.name: Serasum
rites.text: A swift vertical strike used by a single fighter in a duel-focused arena. It was part of that fighter's repertoire across several bouts of an ancient dueling tradition.

rites.name: Niasestor
rites.text: A fighter drives forward while reversing direction and sweeps the blade across the ground in a wide horizontal arc. It is one of several sweeping strikes used in close combat.

rites.name: Valirostium
rites.text: A horizontal strike that rises upward through a swordsman's motion. It is practiced as a basic technique in a blade duel style.

rites.name: Amiareontes
rites.text: A flat sideways strike favored by several fighters of the blade. Its wielders cut across in a single level motion to catch opponents off guard.

rites.name: Vantanum
rites.text: A follow-up technique that a swordsman may unleash only while his spirit-blade is awakened. It extends an earlier divine art, letting the wielder strike with heightened force.

rites.name: Coraronium
rites.text: A piercing strike that cannot be guarded against, a sharper variant of a fighter's standard blow. It splits an opponent's defense open, delivering damage that no shield or parry can stop.

rites.name: Seraulles
rites.text: A fighter whirls sideways into a guarded crouch and then snaps the stance into a fast downward blow. It is a combat maneuver used in close quarters.

rites.name: Orarelium
rites.text: A downward strike technique wielded by a fighter in a blade duel. It was used in earlier versions of the art before being replaced by a newer method.

rites.name: Tirianium
rites.text: A follow-up strike that certain fighters chain after a sideways slash. In later iterations a heavier swing takes its place.

rites.name: Amariantum
rites.text: A vertical strike that fuses two earlier blows into one move. Holding the final input transforms it into a deadlier follow-up.

rites.name: Callor
rites.text: A spinning strike performed while gliding through a winged dance step, lifting the opponent off their feet. It is a technique a skilled dancer can unleash during a particular flowing maneuver.

rites.name: Seraunia
rites.text: A charged technique wielded by a single fighter, drawn from a stored reserve of inner energy. It works much like a surprising flourish that the wielder has long used in earlier contests.

rites.name: Teontiarum
rites.text: A downward strike that a fighter drives through a whirling turn of the body. Two wanderers in the north have learned to unleash it with deadly precision.

rites.name: Valoranum
rites.text: A fighter's hurling technique that was used in earlier duels and was later replaced by a newer dancing maneuver. It belongs to a single combatant's repertoire of throws.

rites.name: Rosia
rites.text: A fighting-style maneuver used by one particular combatant in several contests. It is named for its use to pursue and corner a fleeing opponent.

rites.name: Sastiallor
rites.text: A low-to-the-ground leaping strike used by a wandering blade-fighter. The attacker springs sideways across the field to close distance quickly and surprise the opponent.

rites.name: Sonanum
rites.text: A sneaking low kick that a dodging fighter uses right after a crawling chase move. It follows up on that earlier attack and catches opponents who think the pursuit is over.

rites.name: Tiasium
rites.text: A duelist's upward sweeping blow that lifts the opponent into the air. It is a vertical technique meant to break an enemy's guard from below.

rites.name: Cesolium
rites.text: A swordsman's eight-way running assault that began as a harvest technique and later became its own standalone strike. Its lineage passes through several later forms of the art.

rites.name: Orentanum
rites.text: A fighter may enter a fiery empowered state through certain strikes, wreathing their arms in orange flame and lighting their blade. It lasts until the bout ends and unlocks stronger techniques.

rites.name: Serenus
rites.text: A fighter's technique that can be drawn while the user holds a particular guarded posture. It is a strike performed in that stance.

rites.name: Vellauntus
rites.text: A leaping sideways kick used by a masked duelist, known by several alternate titles across different tournaments. It is one of the jumping kick moves this fighter has relied on since the earliest contests.

rites.name: Telernia
rites.text: A reckless kicking sequence that a wounded fighter may unleash in a dark mood. Its damage grows with each added strike, and a precise hit can flow into a seizing throw.

rites.name: Lirnum
rites.text: A sweeping strike performed in a horizontal arc that moves across the battlefield in eight directions. It was devised as a successor to an older spinning technique.

rites.name: Veosontium
rites.text: A horizontal strike delivered by a wielder who snaps forward with a sudden, toxin-like bite. It belongs to the fighting style of a single cunning warrior.

rites.name: Oresintum
rites.text: A vertical strike performed by a warrior in a sword duel. It is one of the fighter's attacks that come down from above.

rites.name: Valorum
rites.text: A sideways snapping strike used by a wielder during a particular stance. It can be chained into a follow-up lunge that completes the combination.

rites.name: Tiseostanum
rites.text: A sweeping sideways blow used by a dark armored warlord in a dueling tradition. It is performed as one of the fighter's horizontal strikes.

rites.name: Vauneorum
rites.text: A dark veil technique performed by two combatants, drawing a shadowy barrier over the battlefield. It is known to be a move shared between the two users.

rites.name: Reostum
rites.text: A chained run of eight strikes performed by a warrior in a combat tradition. Each blow follows the last in quick succession, building toward a decisive finish.

rites.name: Coriarnus
rites.text: A timed technique where a precisely matched input must be entered to keep a maneuver going and raise its force. Completing every such input in a single maneuver produces a bright pale flash.

rites.name: Oraunanum
rites.text: A low, sweeping strike performed by a fighter crouching with their back turned toward the foe. It is a hidden, horizontal blow delivered from an awkward stance.

rites.name: Maustium
rites.text: A fighter's cancelled strike flows into a mocking gesture, a move that reveals a warrior's calm disdain. It is one of the Brave Edges unique to a particular duelist.

rites.name: Valanus
rites.text: A fighter's sweeping strike that a warrior performs in a wide half-moon arc. It belongs to one champion's set of throwing techniques.

rites.name: Larnintum
rites.text: A downward striking technique a fighter can perform while crouched in a low guard position. It replaces an older aerial split maneuver from the earlier iteration of the craft.

rites.name: Telantum
rites.text: A fighter's leaping sideways strike, performed by a masked dark lord in a dueling hall. It is a horizontal cut delivered mid-jump.

rites.name: Telestus
rites.text: A vertical strike performed by a warrior who has carried it since an earlier age of combat. A second fighter borrows the same technique by copying the first warrior's fighting style.

rites.name: Nelia
rites.text: A downward striking technique used by two rival warriors, launched upward and then driven straight down through an opponent's guard. It is one of several vertical strikes in their repertoire.

rites.name: Telaulia
rites.text: A fighter's technique that can only be called upon during a surge of stored power, drawing them into a sharpened blade-state at the cost of ending that surge early. A practice version lets trainers invoke the same state at any time.

rites.name: Serinernia
rites.text: A vertical strike technique wielded by a fighter with a blade. It sustains its rising arc from the high ground and is used as an offensive maneuver in combat.

rites.name: Viarnales
rites.text: A grappling maneuver where a fighter lifts an opponent and hurls them into the ground. It can be chained into a follow-up strike that sends the foe down into the earth.

rites.name: Cantium
rites.text: A sweeping sideways strike performed by a single wielder in combat. It is favored by one particular duelist who relies on it during bouts.

rites.name: Nenallor
rites.text: A bright, easygoing strike that a fighter unleashes when clashing blades at a tense moment or while charged with spirit. If the wielder turns sullen or her temperament shifts, a grim execution takes its place.

rites.name: Orianeontia
rites.text: A relentless strike that cannot be evaded, fused from a piercing thrust and a rising burst. A single warrior unleashes it to break through any guard.

rites.name: Amosium
rites.text: A battle maneuver used by a warrior while holding a defensive, vengeful stance. It is a strike that lets the fighter unleash a thundering blow.

rites.name: Tilus
rites.text: A ferocious vertical strike used by a dark warlord in a combat contest, where a sudden surge of force erupts upward from the ground.

rites.name: Meosium
rites.text: A spiteful strike used by a shadowy warrior while in a hidden stance, available only when fueled by stored spirit. It fires a sidestep lunge that is instantly followed by a guard-shattering thrust.

rites.name: Lernor
rites.text: A tricky strike that only one fighter may use, drawn from a charged reserve of energy. It is a special technique reserved for a single warrior's repertoire.

rites.name: Viarum Oriantallum
rites.text: A variant of the Dusk-Veil technique that a wielder can unleash while their spirit is fully charged. It is a power learned by a warrior in a duel of blades.

rites.name: Serastor
rites.text: A graceful performance discipline that trained entertainers can learn to shape their craft. Its practitioners are fragile, so heavier martial forms can quickly overwhelm them.

rites.name: Malum
rites.text: A forceful leg technique used by a warrior in a duel. It is one of several strikes that the fighter can deliver with the foot.

rites.name: Lestanum
rites.text: A reckless leap executed while the fighter is unable to see, used as a sudden surprise strike. It is a lesser variant of a more controlled sightless plunge.

rites.name: Loselus
rites.text: A concealed sideways strike performed from behind a fighter's guard, delivered horizontally to catch opponents unaware. It belongs to the repertoire of a single duelist in a combat tradition.

rites.name: Viaraunes
rites.text: A sideways strike technique wielded by a fighter who shifts between two moods. It can only be unleashed in one mood, while the other mood calls forth a different rhythmic blow.

rites.name: Valilesia
rites.text: A sweeping sideways strike performed by a wielder while their blade is held in its sword shape. It slashes across the foe's body in a single broad arc.

rites.name: Cesum
rites.text: A fighting stance used by a masked duelist that sets up a rapid, relentless forward assault. Later refined into a sightless variant that strikes without warning.

rites.name: Corauntum
rites.text: A fighter's combined technique in which a heavy downward strike is followed by a rising sweep of the arm. The two blows are linked into a single continuous sequence.

rites.name: Valeosoles
rites.text: A follow-up strike that comes directly after a sideways claw attack. It is used by a skilled fighter in close combat.

rites.name: Nesaunor
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder reshape their blade mid-combat. The change alters the weapon's form without setting aside the fight.

rites.name: Telarum
rites.text: A horizontal strike delivered by a fighter who has turned their back to the foe while lowered close to the ground. It is a sweeping technique used in close combat.

rites.name: Teollestia
rites.text: A fighter drops low and skids forward across the ground to strike an opponent's legs. It is a sliding attack used in close combat duels.

rites.name: Coreostus Cesiles
rites.text: A grappling maneuver performed by a masked fighter who stands behind an opponent and seizes them. It is one of the fighter's throws.

rites.name: Coreoriales
rites.text: A devastating final strike that a warrior unleashes only while a sacred inner force is awakened. Without that force, the warrior releases a lesser blast instead.

rites.name: Cosor
rites.text: A paired striking technique used by two fighters together. It is one of the kicks they employ in combat, drawing on a shared rhythm and timing.

rites.name: Maurosum
rites.text: A swift sideways strike used by two fierce wielders of the old arts. A slower variant of the same motion is also known among them.

rites.name: Sausor
rites.text: A coiling lunge technique used by a masked fighter that drives forward low along the ground. Later it can be chained into a rapid flurry of strikes.

rites.name: Rerallia
rites.text: A swift, forceful technique used by a warrior in close combat. It is one of the signature maneuvers that first appears in a later chapter of a legendary duel-based fighting saga.

rites.name: Corantanum
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which the user turns their back toward an opponent before striking in a rapid flurry. It is a blind, reversed version of a related flurry move.

rites.name: Amiantaurum
rites.text: A whirling combat technique in which a warrior spins rapidly through a sequence of eight strikes. It belongs to a single fighter's repertoire of moves.

rites.name: Amiantum
rites.text: A swift follow-up technique in which a wielder spins a blade in rapid succession after an earlier flourish. It replaces an older, simpler maneuver once favored by the same fighter.

rites.name: Mirnentia
rites.text: A charged spinning technique that a warrior can unleash only while her spirit is fully awakened. It is a stronger form of an older whirling strike, built to hit harder when the spirit surges.

rites.name: Viasus
rites.text: A wide sideways strike used by a warrior in a fighting duel. It cuts horizontally across the foe's body during combat.

rites.name: Valiania
rites.text: A hurling technique that a fighter uses to toss an opponent to the ground. It is performed by a hulking brawler in a dueling tradition.

rites.name: Nolanum Amialium
rites.text: A fighting technique that belongs to a set of eight linked movements used by a warrior. It is performed as part of a continuous sequence of attacks.

rites.name: Cellum
rites.text: A follow-up technique built on an earlier swing, wielded by two rival fighters. It draws on the same inner force that powered the original motion.

rites.name: Corallor
rites.text: A bearer may call forth a single fleeting technique only while carrying a sphere of light. If the sphere is already fixed in place, a different hidden art takes its position instead.

rites.name: Niastanum
rites.text: A downward striking technique performed by a fighter who swings from above. It is one of the vertical attacks used in combat.

rites.name: Amantosor
rites.text: A downward strike used by one fighter in a combat arena. It forces opponents to guard against an assault coming from overhead.

rites.name: Telianor
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal beam technique wielded by two combatants in the wider realm. It slices across the field in a flat, level arc.

rites.name: Vestium
rites.text: A bold vertical technique in which a fighter strikes eight times along the rising line of an opponent's body. It was refined in a single arcade-era contest tradition.

rites.name: Valeontia Seriania
rites.text: A sweeping sideways strike that a fighter throws while turned away from the foe, delivered with the back to the enemy. It is a technique of the blade-arts.

rites.name: Nernaustes
rites.text: A paired striking technique in which two fighters follow a hard downward blow with a sweeping low kick. It is performed as a combined move shared by a duo.

rites.name: Valialor Vellosor
rites.text: A swift rising strike that a wielder performs right after a rapid opening thrust, turning the first attack into a follow-up. It is a technique passed down among skilled blade fighters.

rites.name: Corallum Sareostor
rites.text: A downward vertical slash that a warrior uses against an opponent. It is one of the standard attacks wielded by two duelists in the arena.

rites.name: Nauria
rites.text: A downward-driven thrust that a fighter uses in close combat, sweeping low across the ground. It belongs to the wielder's own repertoire of sideways blows.

rites.name: Coraunium
rites.text: A low, sweeping kick performed from a crouch that a brawler has used since first appearing in a clash of blades. A rival fighter shares the same motion in a later duel.

rites.name: Nillanum
rites.text: A fighting posture where a warrior grips the blade in the off hand, mirroring a familiar guard. It appears only in one tournament-era duel manual.

rites.name: Ciarnor
rites.text: A low leg strike used by a fighter in a blade duel, delivered as one of several kicking techniques. It sweeps at the opponent's footing from close range.

rites.name: Reolianes
rites.text: A fighter's backward-turning kick that lands against the opponent's skull. It is one of the striking techniques used by a duelist in combat.

rites.name: Valirnolia
rites.text: A fighter's sweeping strike that a warrior can unleash during a frenzied surge of combat. It is performed as one of the moves available within that heightened state.

rites.name: Seronia
rites.text: A signature throwing technique used by a fearsome warrior in a dueling arena. It lets the wielder seize an opponent and hurl them to the ground.

rites.name: Soriantium
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter follows a forceful shoulder charge with a sharp finishing strike. It is practiced as a signature sequence by one of the duelists.

rites.name: Tialentor
rites.text: A ascending whirling practice that follows a basic spinning rite, performed by one tradesperson-warrior in a sharp-edged contest of skill. It rises from the first spin into a higher, stronger motion.

rites.name: Nausanus
rites.text: A bladed technique performed from a hovering stance that cannot be blocked. It descends in a vertical strike and is known by a later, grander name.

rites.name: Sernium Sirium
rites.text: A variant of a towering strike that hurls a foe skyward, then drives them back toward the wielder. It was once a free technique and later became a separate, powerful finishing move.

rites.name: Taustirnus
rites.text: A vertical strike in which the wielder sweeps a heavy blade upward to hurl an opponent into the air. Practitioners of the fighting style rely on it to open an enemy's guard.

rites.name: Nosiarus
rites.text: A tenacious strike that cannot be stopped or deflected by any guard. Certain fighters of the Wrenlow circle are able to perform it.

rites.name: Neoniastia
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter hurls an opponent backward over the shoulder. It is later superseded by a different technique in a newer contest of arms.

rites.name: Valeliranum
rites.text: A swift counterstrike technique that a pair of warriors can perform during a gliding evasion. A third fighter may also learn it by perfectly deflecting an incoming blow with a shielding guard.

rites.name: Lerinium
rites.text: A sweeping eight-strike rush used by a fierce duelist, the motion can be continued into a follow-up thrust. It belongs to a single warrior's repertoire of drills.

rites.name: Ceornalum
rites.text: A fighter drives forward into a shoulder barge and then sweeps upward with a rising strike. It is one of several chained sequences used in duels.

rites.name: Veontiares
rites.text: A grappling maneuver used by a swordsman when a quick twisting thrust connects during an enemy's attack. It exists only in one particular duel-training craft.

rites.name: Telor
rites.text: A low, sweeping technique in which a fighter drives a staff downward toward an opponent's legs. Its variants are named in several languages across different editions.

rites.name: Raurnenum
rites.text: A grappling art where the wielder sacrifices a portion of their own vitality to pour it into a captured foe. If the foe slips free, the wielder instead drains the foe and mends their own wounds.

rites.name: Oriallostum
rites.text: A sweeping horizontal strike that a fighter unleashes right after a spinning overhead blow. A rival warrior has a similar version that lands one more blow.

rites.name: Rantia
rites.text: A flexible fighting art open to any custom wanderer who learns it. It lets practitioners borrow the combat styles of others, except for those bound to a few chosen warriors.

rites.name: Restia
rites.text: A fighter's eight-strike combo sequence, executed as a running attack. It belongs to a single warrior's repertoire of moves in a duel-based arena contest.

rites.name: Nesiaror
rites.text: A grappling strike that a fighter has long carried in her repertoire. Another warrior who borrows her fighting style can perform the same grip as well.

rites.name: Corauntes
rites.text: A grappling art where the wielder pulls vitality from a foe and adds it to their own body. If the victim slips free, the wielder instead surrenders strength so the foe is healed, and successful drains grant spiritual sparks that unlock stronger strikes.

rites.name: Mentallum
rites.text: A rearward kick that a fighter performs while facing away from the opponent. It is used as a strike when the fighter's back is turned toward the enemy.

rites.name: Serauneolia
rites.text: A sweeping eight-directional strike used by a duelist in a long-ago contest of blades. It appears only in one particular tournament.

rites.name: Oriselles
rites.text: A spinning leg strike used by a fighter of the Dragon Sect. It appears in every contest where the fighter can be controlled.

rites.name: Mosus Naulles
rites.text: A kick technique performed by a fighter who is rising from the ground. It is used by two warriors who favor this sudden upward motion.

rites.name: Osazyutheth
rites.text: Osazyutheth is the concept of the wall that holds: the idea that a built barrier can outlast the force pressed against it. In the Walled Age it was bound into the stone orders and church masonry that kept the first crossings from flooding the valleys. Its power is measured in the patience of mortar and the refusal of foundations to give way.

rites.name: Tarintium
rites.text: Tarintium is a concept of the Walled Age in Morurnath, the principle that a held wall is a promise kept across centuries of orders and churches. It was first named during the Age of the first sovereign, when groves and growing kingdoms learned to measure their borders in stone and oath.

rites.name: Serestallum
rites.text: A calling that a wanderer may take up, allowing the practitioner to wield a wide spread of blades, from short daggers to long reaches. Certain sacred echoes can be bound to those who follow this path.

rites.name: Teliares
rites.text: A grappling maneuver that a fighter performs after striking an opponent, in which the attacker pulls the foe into a throw. It follows a successful opening blow in a rushing combination.

rites.name: Corisaranum
rites.text: A horizontal strike that a warrior can unleash during a clash of counter-blades. A later refinement ensures that the third blow always sets it off.

rites.name: Seresanum
rites.text: A fighter's technique for seizing an opponent's sharp weapon mid-strike with bare hands. It is performed while fighting unarmed.

rites.name: Ameonia
rites.text: A rearward-rising kick technique used by a swift warrior in a later-era combat tradition. It was later superseded by a different strike that carries the same name in a successor cycle.

rites.name: Leosor
rites.text: A fighter's technique of rapid, spiraling strikes that flows from one chained movement into the next. It is one of the eight-step combination sequences used in close combat.

rites.name: Orestilor
rites.text: A sweeping sideways strike that a dark warrior can unleash, following on from a grim opening maneuver. It serves as a finishing sequence in a combat art.

rites.name: Seriarnanum
rites.text: A high kick technique used by a fighter in a duel of blades. It is a strike that rises swiftly toward the opponent's head.

rites.name: Leniasium
rites.text: A follow-up technique that a fighter uses after a rival's strike. It can be unleashed without draining any reserved energy, and a second practitioner later adopts it.

rites.name: Saules
rites.text: A fighter's combat technique in which several rapid attacks are pressed together at once. It is one of the striking moves a warrior can unleash in a duel.

rites.name: Nornia
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter in a special guarded posture launches into a swift leaping strike. It is available only while the warrior holds that particular stance.

rites.name: Teosernia
rites.text: A fighter's forceful knee strike that is part of a kick-based attack set in a dueling arena. It belongs to one warrior's repertoire of combat moves.

rites.name: Orilornum
rites.text: A fighter's charged reservoir that fills through striking and defending, then empties to power special moves. A last-round surge grants one extra measure to those close to defeat.

rites.name: Veollontia
rites.text: A heightened form of a whirling strike that a dueling artist can unleash once their inner energy has been fully stirred. It is a more powerful version of a basic spinning technique.

rites.name: Niantia Narialor
rites.text: A fighter places a glowing orb in the air to perform a set technique. If the orb already rests in place, a different technique is performed instead.

rites.name: Rirnia
rites.text: A fighter's rising kick-strike is performed with a sudden turn of the body. It is one of the combat maneuvers belonging to a single warrior in the duel-arena tradition.

rites.name: Cianium
rites.text: A follow-up technique a fighter can chain during a reversal exchange. It lets the user continue an attack straight after a successful counter in a duel.

rites.name: Teolasor
rites.text: A fighter's upward kicking technique, used as one of the strikes available in a dueling art. It launches an opponent skyward during combat.

rites.name: Amirostum
rites.text: A sideways strike from a hidden blade that a masked duelist uses in combat. It can be chained into a spinning follow-up that completes the sequence.

rites.name: Valonernium
rites.text: A vertical strike performed by a wielder who has their orb set in place. It sends a rival's body from the lowest point upward in a sweeping motion.

rites.name: Sonentes
rites.text: A horizontal strike used in combat, delivered by a fighter moving low across the battlefield. It sweeps through the opponent's guard in a single flowing motion.

rites.name: Vanaustus
rites.text: A combat maneuver that a fighter may unleash when two strikes collide mid-clash. It is one of several moves that can be chosen at that moment of a contest.

rites.name: Valialor
rites.text: A heavy lunging assault empowered by a surge of stored fury, letting its wielder press forward without flinching when struck. It can only be unleashed once the bearer's inner reserve is fully awakened.

rites.name: Seriliastum
rites.text: A hurled maneuver that a fighter uses in a dueling arena, performed by a single command input. It belongs to one particular combatant's repertoire of moves.

rites.name: Cinteolles
rites.text: A bright strike used by a warrior in combat, first unleashed in a recent duel. It is a sweeping technique that rewards careful timing.

rites.name: Vares
rites.text: A spinning fighting technique passed down among certain warriors, performed as a whirling strike that a second warrior can also learn by sharing the first one's fighting style.

rites.name: Orinium
rites.text: A deceptive follow-up maneuver that a masked duelist once used across several swordfighting sequels. It catches opponents who expect the usual next move.

rites.name: Minaurus
rites.text: A heightened form of two linked strikes that a fighter can unleash while their inner energy is fully charged. It draws on the same rhythm as the two older moves it grows from.

rites.name: Cillia
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which a sustained press of a control lets them unleash a thrust of the spear. It is a stance-linked surge of combat power used in a duel.

rites.name: Listausium
rites.text: A combat maneuver that follows a thrust with two low crossbow shots fired in quick succession by a skilled duelist. It is a special attack in a fighting contest.

rites.name: Vinanum
rites.text: A coordinated strike technique that a fighter can unleash by pressing two attack commands at the same moment. It is one of the moves a warrior can call upon in a duel.

rites.name: Corauntor
rites.text: A charged technique that a fighter can unleash once their spirit is fully awakened. It lets the user strike with a sudden, dazzling blow in a duel.

rites.name: Lolium
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter extend certain strikes into a chain of follow-up blows by pressing a specific button combination after entering a move. Using it spends half of a stored power reserve.

rites.name: Rollaurnium
rites.text: A swift technique where a fighter sweeps across the ground in every direction with a rapid darting rush. Two practitioners are said to have mastered its quick, horizontal strikes.

rites.name: Cilleostia
rites.text: A fighting posture that a warrior can assume to shift into a spear-wielding mode. Adopting it changes the combatant's weapon style for the duration of a clash.

rites.name: Cintium
rites.text: A jagged blade technique performed while the wielder faces away from the foe. It is a reworked version of a stronger, more ecstatic strike used from the front.

rites.name: Vaseror
rites.text: A dark strike that three fighters can unleash, sometimes only after drawing power into a charged state. It was first born in an early duel-blade tale and later returned in revised form.

rites.name: Corentia
rites.text: A downward striking technique that a warrior uses to slash from above. It is a replacement for an older maneuver and remains part of the fighter's repertoire afterward.

rites.name: Corosanum
rites.text: A low, sweeping hooking strike used by a fighter in a duel. It hits the opponent's midsection with a horizontal arc.

rites.name: Raunisia
rites.text: A grappling throw performed by a dark-armored warlord when he stands to the left of his foe. It is a move used in a dueling contest.

rites.name: Teornisus
rites.text: A coiling strike of the duelist's spirit, unleashed as an attack of the soul. It was added to the arts in a later revision of the training grounds.

rites.name: Tenanum
rites.text: A horizontal eight-directional rush that follows up an earlier wave technique. It is performed by a pair of fighters working together in a coordinated assault.

rites.name: Miastentor
rites.text: A mocking gesture performed by a fighter who slaps her own rear toward the opponent. It is a playful provocation used during a duel to unsettle the rival.

rites.name: Miasum
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes an opponent while standing at their right flank. It is performed in a duel between armored combatants.

rites.name: Riasanum
rites.text: A stronger form of a spiraling whirlwind technique, empowered by a surge of gathered soul energy. A fighter who has drawn that energy can unleash it in a far more violent sweep.

rites.name: Valiales
rites.text: A signature strike of a masked duelist, unleashed in a single ancient arena. It appears only in the later editions of a combat tradition.

rites.name: Neorniasor
rites.text: A low-stance striking maneuver that a fighter performs by dropping close to the ground before delivering a downward blow. It is carried by a certain champion and a dark-aspected fighting style.

rites.name: Valosantium
rites.text: A command throw that lets a fighter seize an opponent and then rise into a hovering stance right afterward. The fighter drifts upward instead of dropping back to the ground.

rites.name: Orialausor
rites.text: A fiery technique named by one name in one telling and another elsewhere, it is a follow-up strike that a fighter has known since first appearing in the arena.

rites.name: Oreontum
rites.text: A chained strike sequence used by a fighter in a duelling arena. Its opening blow may shatter an opponent's guard, and its follow-up can shift into a feint or a simple low sweep.

rites.name: Coronillum
rites.text: A vertical strike technique wielded by a single fighter, replacing an older signature blow in the combat art of their school. It is a practiced maneuver used in duels.

rites.name: Coraseontes
rites.text: A swift strike performed by a wielder who has entered a misty, hazy stance. It can only be unleashed from that shrouded posture, making it a technique of stealth and sudden reach.

rites.name: Teleoniases
