rites.text: A fighter's follow-up kick that spins the body into a whirling burst. It carries on from an earlier move and is used across several bouts of the same style.

rites.name: Amianus
rites.text: A stronger form of guarding that repels every kind of strike, even those that cannot normally be blocked. It drains a portion of the fighter's reserve energy, and a successful use restores much of their defensive stamina.

rites.name: Lontales
rites.text: A low, sweeping kick technique used by a few trained fighters in a duelling tradition. One of the practitioners can follow it with a rising variant that carries the momentum upward.

rites.name: Lolestium
rites.text: A horizontal strike used by two fighters, drawn in a sweeping motion that cuts across the body of a foe.

rites.name: Vaullus
rites.text: A violent soul-based strike used by one warrior in a dueling tradition. It was added to the fighting style during a later revision of the art.

rites.name: Corollor
rites.text: A deceptive maneuver used by a warrior to mislead an opponent before striking from above. It belongs to a set of downward strikes practiced in a fighting style.

rites.name: Valasilor
rites.text: A fighter's forceful leg strike that a pair of duelists in the same martial tradition can perform. It is known as a deadly technique in close combat.

rites.name: Viales
rites.text: A signature technique a warrior can unleash only while in a dark, brooding state. It is one of her unique combat moves within a fighting-style tradition.

rites.name: Coraunus
rites.text: A fearsome exclusive technique wielded by one of the combatants, unlocked only when that fighter's spirit gauge is fully charged. It unleashes a devastating final strike.

rites.name: Coreonales
rites.text: A rising strike used by two fighters, who launch upward into a vertical attack. It is known by another name in one regional version.

rites.name: Vauria
rites.text: A soaring aerial maneuver that two companions perform while floating above the ground. It is used as a strike during a hovering stance.

rites.name: Oriniastia
rites.text: A dormant technique of the wielder's own edge that lets an unlikely fate take hold, twisting events into a sudden and decisive turn when the moment is right.

rites.name: Caullistor
rites.text: A powerful follow-up blast that a wielder can unleash after a related earlier strike. In one version it is a special finishing move, and in another it requires the wielder to be charged with spirit energy.

rites.name: Tialus
rites.text: A downward striking technique in which a fighter follows a overhead slash with a low sweeping blow. It is built by linking two known maneuvers together into one continuous combination.

rites.name: Amelus
rites.text: A vertical strike performed by a fighter who wields a blade in a duel. It rises upward and then descends, breaking an opponent's guard.

rites.name: Oraresanum
rites.text: A dangerous technique used by a warrior in a duel, unleashing a forceful strike meant to drive opponents away. It appears in the combat arts of a particular fighter.

rites.name: Valaria
rites.text: A rising strike that a dark-armored duelist has carried through several contests. A stronger, unblockable variant takes its place in one later version of the contest.

rites.name: Amilanum
rites.text: A swift, low striking technique used by a warrior of an ancient duelist school. It sweeps the foe's footing with a heavy heel.

rites.name: Mallum
rites.text: A grappling maneuver used by a masked swordsman that hurls an opponent through the air. It can be performed only while the fighter's power is charged, replacing a standard throw.

rites.name: Corostanum
rites.text: A bracing counter-strike technique used by a wandering duelist after an opening maneuver lands cleanly or catches a leaping foe. It finishes the exchange with a sudden, held blow.

rites.name: Ameontanum
rites.text: A rapid-fire suppressive technique that a warrior can unleash while holding a special guarded posture. It is one of several strikes available only from that stance.

rites.name: Mentanum
rites.text: A vertical striking technique wielded by one fighter, later shared with another who mirrors her fighting style. It is a move that rises upward through an opponent's guard.

rites.name: Raurus
rites.text: A fighting stance that lets a warrior channel a pair of borrowed wings to lift skyward. It can only be entered after completing certain specific attack sequences.

rites.name: Orarnus
rites.text: A spiraling strike that a warrior can unleash only while a sphere rests in its designated place. If the sphere is carried instead, a different technique is performed.

rites.name: Cianaustium
rites.text: A downward striking maneuver used by a warrior in combat. It is delivered from above with a blade, cutting straight down onto an opponent.

rites.name: Orostenium
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter hurls a sweeping leg blow at an opponent. It belongs to a set of kicks used by a particular warrior in a duel-focused arena.

rites.name: Sereoraulum
rites.text: A fighting technique that unleashes a sequence of eight blows in a single rushing combination. It belongs to one warrior's repertoire of signature attacks.

rites.name: Seraustalia
rites.text: A airborne fighting technique that lets a warrior strike sideways across the battlefield. It is one of several horizontal attack forms used by a skilled combatant.

rites.name: Causes
rites.text: A defensive technique in which a guard is raised at the exact instant an enemy strike lands, producing a blue glow and a timing edge. It stops nearly every blow except seizing grabs and the deadliest finishing strikes.

rites.name: Sostia
rites.text: A technique that cannot be blocked, which a single fighter can use in a duel of arms. It is one of the signature strikes of a particular combatant.

rites.name: Seorium
rites.text: A basic sideways strike used by a fighter in a duel. It is one of the standard horizontal attacks in the fighter's repertoire.

rites.name: Riantes
rites.text: A follow-up strike that a skilled duelist unleashes right after a heavy stomp, carried out with a practiced rhythm. It is used by fighters who master a particular combat tradition.

rites.name: Valostor
rites.text: A follow-up technique that a character can perform while their soul is charged, building on an earlier fluid-like move. It is a powerful ability tied to one fighter's skill set.

rites.name: Cialeosia
rites.text: A charged technique that a warrior can unleash only while their soul energy is fully surged. It is one of the special maneuvers available to a specific fighter in a duel-focused combat tradition.

rites.name: Valinum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that reshapes her blade into a different form mid-combat. It is performed as a single maneuver during play.

rites.name: Oreosolus
rites.text: A flowing eight-direction rush technique performed by a dancer-warrior, striking upward along a vertical path. It is one of her signature combat moves.

rites.name: Raurnes
rites.text: A strike that a warrior can unleash only when the spirit within has been fully charged. It is a modified form of an older killing technique, and a harsher version of it also exists.

rites.name: Tauntum
rites.text: A hovering technique that a warrior draws upon in combat. It is performed while suspended in the air and delivers a strike from above.

rites.name: Tenium
rites.text: A combined technique a warrior unlocks when two heightened focus states both reach their peak. It delivers a decisive finishing strike in close combat.

rites.name: Careonium
rites.text: A radiant technique wielded by a single fighter, unleashing a burst of brilliant energy in a sudden blow. It is known by more than one name depending on the region where it is recorded.

rites.name: Risaunes
rites.text: A combined technique in which a fighter performs a knee thrust and immediately follows with a downward blade strike. It appears as a special finishing sequence available in later combat trials.

rites.name: Tastelor
rites.text: A charged cry is unleashed by a warrior who has gathered inner power, marking the end of a rapid chain of strikes. When fully empowered, the warrior's form transforms into a dark mount.

rites.name: Cesaunia
rites.text: A bleak technique in which a wielder of dark arts unleashes a soul-rending strike. It may be chained into a second, deeper assault that pulls the victim downward.

rites.name: Teostes
rites.text: A reactive maneuver where a wielder answers an incoming blow by striking back during an evasive dodge. It can only be performed while holding a particular defensive stance.

rites.name: Serenum
rites.text: A leaping, vertical strike performed by a fighter in a dueling arena. It rises sharply upward to catch an opponent off guard.

rites.name: Telontaror
rites.text: A low leg strike used by a warrior of the wandering blade-duelists. Later schools of combat carry near-identical forms under altered names.

rites.name: Tiarnaulum
rites.text: A fighter's unblockable technique in which he sneezes onto his foe. Its windup varies unpredictably, sometimes quick and sometimes drawn out with a couple of head pulls before the sneeze lands.

rites.name: Amernaunia
rites.text: A signature throw belonging to a fighter in a dueling tradition. It is performed during close combat and is known to be one of the practitioner's characteristic techniques.

rites.name: Caurnus
rites.text: A reversed grappling throw that a fighter uses on an opponent hovering in the air while she turns her back to them. It is performed as a variation of her crouching ambush move.

rites.name: Tonarnus
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a single warrior in combat. The text only says it is one of her attacks, so this entry describes it as a strike she performs in duels.

rites.name: Meornes
rites.text: A aerial technique a fighter can perform while hovering in the air. It is one of the moves available to a figure while floating.

rites.name: Ceolium
rites.text: A ritual strike that a warrior performs while holding a particular vengeful posture. It is a technique tied to one fighter's combat style.

rites.name: Valisor
rites.text: A combat technique where a well-timed blow hurls the foe backward and, after enough successful hits, shatters their protective plating. Sometimes it arrives by chance when a counter-parry turns the tide.

rites.name: Tales
rites.text: A fighter's low sweeping strike, one of the kicks a combatant uses in a duel. It is part of a fighting style passed down through a single warrior's repertoire.

rites.name: Maustor
rites.text: A rising strike used by a warrior while climbing upward in battle, which can be continued by a second powerful ascending attack.

rites.name: Rollanum
rites.text: A grappling maneuver used by a skilled dancer-warrior, performed by seizing an opponent from behind. It returns in later forms of the art only when she shifts into a specific guarded posture.

rites.name: Sarnaulium
rites.text: A rare inner condition that a fighter can slip into during a duel, granting them a heightened combat state. It belongs to a single wielder who knows how to reach it.

rites.name: Ameornintes
rites.text: A bladed technique used by one warrior in combat, in which a sequence of strikes is performed to unlock a hidden power within the attack.

rites.name: Reorillum
rites.text: A coiled strike performed by a swordsman who turns his back to a rival, then lashes out suddenly. It is one of the moves a fighter may use while facing away from an opponent.

rites.name: Laurnium
rites.text: A rising strike performed with a blade that lifts an opponent into the air. The wielder uses a forceful upward motion to launch the foe skyward.

rites.name: Leosirum
rites.text: A horizontal eight-way running strike wielded by a fighter who has charged her inner power. Without that charge, the fighter performs a circular sweeping slash instead.

rites.name: Ciseres
rites.text: A spinning strike technique wielded by a single fighter, carried across several eras of combat. A later refined version of the technique exists, enhancing its force.

rites.name: Amiantes
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter channel a sharp corrosive current through their spiritual essence. It was added to the arts of a warrior in a later revision of the training manuals.

rites.name: Tauntaror
rites.text: A kicking technique that a fighter gains and can perform only from one particular guard position. In a later version it is restricted to a different guard stance.

rites.name: Coraustus
rites.text: A grappling throw carried by one fighter in the duelling arts, an enhanced form of an older hurling technique. It appears in two recent tournament editions.

rites.name: Meorernium
rites.text: A fighter performs a rising, eight-hit combo sequence as a signature technique. It is one of the many combat moves a warrior can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Lerniarium
rites.text: A fighter's sweeping rotating kick that follows a strike to the middle of the body. It is performed while the attacker holds a steady stance.

rites.name: Rillium
rites.text: A brutal bodily strike that two rival warriors use in a modern dueling arena. It is shared by both fighters as a signature technique.

rites.name: Orialastus
rites.text: A two-vessel ritual repairs a damaged keepsake store. The keeper swaps a blank vessel with the marred one, then restores the saved tokens and writes them back into the new vessel.

rites.name: Oraria
rites.text: A fighting posture that a warrior can only reach after performing specific strikes. It serves as the required gateway into another advanced stance.

rites.name: Losentum
rites.text: A ferocious multi-headed assault that a warrior unleashes in a rapid flurry. It can only be called upon once a special energy within the fighter has been fully charged.

rites.name: Sorus
rites.text: A swift technique that a single fighter uses to dash across the field and strike from every direction in a sweeping rush.

rites.name: Raurnia
rites.text: A soaring strike that catches a foe mid-air and turns into a grappling hold on them. It is performed during a serpent-like stance.

rites.name: Ceorum Serelles
rites.text: A refined variant of an earlier rite of righteousness, sharpened into a more potent strike that a duelist can unleash. It is a technique drawn from a long-practiced method of combat.

rites.name: Cestus
rites.text: A ritual strike that answers only when performed on an uneven count, drawing a luminous blade from the bearer's spirit. On even counts a dark twin technique awakens instead.

rites.name: Velanum
rites.text: A fighter's technique within a sequence of eight linked strikes, granted to them in a later contest and replacing an earlier illusion-style move.

rites.name: Solor
rites.text: A leaping strike technique performed from a particular fighting pose. It is a variant of an older aerial maneuver, known to practitioners who adopt that pose.

rites.name: Torinia
rites.text: A devastating combat technique where a warrior channels stored spiritual energy from a heavy overhead strike into a sweeping, airborne follow-up. The maneuver is performed only from a particular low, coiled posture.

rites.name: Corostanum Valoles
rites.text: A fighter's aerial strike that begins with a leaping kick and finishes with a second, follow-up kick. It is a signature move belonging to a single warrior.

rites.name: Amiarnillia
rites.text: A grappling maneuver that wraps an opponent in a rushing current of air to hurl them down. Its unstoppable form once faded, leaving a new hidden technique to strike past defenses.

rites.name: Coranirium
rites.text: A paired cyclical maneuver that a warrior channels through a soul-driven strike, looping the force back into itself. It was added to the arts during a later refinement of the fighting system.

rites.name: Tausolor
rites.text: A swift technique a wielder performs while holding a particular ready posture. It is one of several strikes available from that stance.

rites.name: Oreollum
rites.text: A violent technique a fighter may unleash while holding a blade in an aggressive stance. It is one of several strikes available to that stance.

rites.name: Tirornes
rites.text: A swift technique that a fighter can call upon while holding a particular stance. It lets the user slip through space in an instant to reposition.

rites.name: Resium
rites.text: A counter-strike that a fighter unleashes when struck during a sustained surge of power. It replaces an older, similar retaliation and is absent from a later installment, where a newer protective mechanic covers certain attacks.

rites.name: Coreria
rites.text: A practitioner's empowered spinning technique, a stronger form of a heavier coiling strike, unleashed when their inner spirit is fully charged. It relies on a flowing, drifting motion.

rites.name: Cenaurnum
rites.text: A soul-based assault technique wielded by a warrior, drawn from the spiritual edge of a fighting style. It was added to the arsenal through a later revision of the combat system.

rites.name: Niarolus
rites.text: A dark burst of hollow force that a warrior unleashes from a blade. A later wielder may only call upon it while charged with spirit energy.

rites.name: Mauntor
rites.text: A ranged strike that sweeps sideways through the air like a cracking lash. It is one of the sideways moves a duelist can use in the arena.

rites.name: Lonaurus
rites.text: A devastating strike unleashed while a wielder holds a dark cosmic stance. It is one of several assaults that this fighter can deliver in that posture.

rites.name: Corintium Cisum
rites.text: A mournful blade technique held within a fighter's arsenal. It is a special attack that strikes with a sorrowful edge.

rites.name: Druraneld
rites.text: Druraneld is a grounded, era-E6 event in which a single kunai-style dagger strike is conjured into a rising arc of fire that bursts skyward after a short blink across the ground. Its practitioners rely on quick, strategic bursts rather than brute force, and the blaze it leaves hangs in the air as a warning long after the duel ends.

rites.name: Brerdoldock
rites.text: Brerdoldock is a crystalline sentinel-blade forged in the frozen spires of Vhalorin to sever the hungry rot called the Maw. Its wielders draw a steady mending light from it that offsets the wounds their enemies inflict, and in its own guarded shape it has never once turned against its bearer.

rites.name: Drarnath
rites.text: Drarnath is a dreamer-turned-blademaster of Morurnath who drinks in the strength of whatever she devours, her soul a hollow vessel that grows heavier with each absorbed existence. Her twin crescent blades answer to her will without ever being touched, as though they were carved from her own memories. She walks the Grounded realm in quiet isolation, feared for the chaos she carries within.

rites.name: Joroldere
rites.text: Joroldere is a wandering cartographer of sealed ruins in the Grounded realm of Morurnath, bound to a ledger that remembers every road ever walked. Their weathered compass can briefly quiet the tremors that rattle the valley towns, though each use costs them a year of memory.

rites.name: Tarnorudon
rites.text: Tarnorudon is a grounded concept in Morurnath, a sword-and-bloodline art that trades raw force for precise, stacked rotations. Its practitioners are said to spin a single low sweep into a chain of hidden follow-ups, so the final strike arrives from an angle nobody watching expected. Old instructors call it the art of the turning tide.

rites.name: Pelolderon
rites.text: Pelolderon is a grounded, mortal-scale concept in the Morurnath omniverse, a warrior who borrows the stances of rival duelists to channel a whirling tempest. Its strikes are measured in the force of a fast kick or a falling beam rather than anything cosmic, and it can only summon this gale while mimicking a master it has studied.

rites.name: Kelardudar
rites.text: Kelardudar is a concept of resonant silt-weaving within the Morurnath omniverse, a practice that gathers loose sediment into taut, humming lattices. Its practitioners in the E6 era use the technique to brace riverbanks and to snap wheeled carts loose from mud. Kelardudar remains a grounded craft with no reach beyond the reach of a single well-rooted hand.

rites.name: Haludorne
rites.text: Haludorne is a grounded combat stance-technique, honed over three ages by a warden-duelist named Haludorne who drew power from enduring pain. Its signature is a stored surge of resolve that detonates back into the attacker when a strike lands at mid or high height.

rites.name: Fenoston
rites.text: Fenoston is a wind-dancer of the Grounded realm who turns a gust of its own breath into a spiraling ascent. Its leaps are triggered only when an adversary strikes while the dancer is mid-motion, so the rival's aggression becomes the fuel for the rise. The technique has been passed down through three generations of its sect.

rites.name: Moradostock
rites.text: Moradostock is a hand-sized brass clockwork gyroscope that its wardens spin up to store kinetic momentum for a single decisive hurl. Locals in the lower quarters of Morurnath trust it more than any blade or lock, though its gears wear down quickly under heavy use.

rites.name: Thuren
rites.text: Thuren is a grounded wandering duelist of the E6 age, a person of three years' standing in a mountain-valley world where the ground itself is treated as a partner in combat. Known for dropping into a spinning low sweep that lands with a sharp, bone-jarring crack, Thuren keeps the technique as a quiet point of pride.

rites.name: Halerde
rites.text: Halerde is a grounded-realm sparring art of the E6 era, practiced by wandering drillmasters who teach that a single well-timed strike can shake the bones of a stone wall. Its third generation of masters has refined a leaping heel technique, said to carry the weight of a falling roof beam into one swift blow. The art is taught more for discipline than for destruction.

rites.name: Peluderdock
rites.text: Peluderdock is a grounded concept of a spring-loaded, fur-covered mechanical stalk that the drifting caravans of Morurnath use as a hand tool and an emergency siege weapon. Its shape and rhythm are borrowed from ritual sword-dances practiced by the sand-walkers of its era, and it is rarely used against anything bigger than a barricade.

rites.name: Thanar
rites.text: thanar is a kinetic marvel that channels the raw force of a collapsing tide into a single, earth‑bound strike. the technique is performed by the legendary tide‑walker, mae‑sira, who channels the ocean’s surge into a focused, ground‑pounding blast that can level a small cliff face with a single footfall. when unleashed, the impact resonates through the very bedrock, creating a shockwave that ripples across the surrounding terrain.

rites.name: Kelornen
rites.text: Kelornen is a grounded concept in the Morurnath omniverse, a meditative discipline of bladed stillness taught in the high valley shrines of the E6 era. Its practitioners are said to strike so cleanly that an opponent's guard simply forgets to exist for a heartbeat.

rites.name: Kelestonar
rites.text: Kelestonar is a grounded sky-tide: a slow-moving storm-spirit of the E6 coastal reaches, where ancient fishing-clans once bound its currents with tidal chimes. Its signature act is the Lantern Surge, a rolling wave of wind that can toss a fleet of ships like driftwood.

rites.name: Fenodeldath
rites.text: Fenodeldath is a hand-forged lantern-blade whose glow dims with each oath broken by its bearer, a brass-and-glass relic kept by the river-wardens of Morurnath's grounded reaches. Its wielders are trained to read the flicker of its flame as a measure of their own honesty.

rites.name: Feneldock
rites.text: Feneldock is a grounded concept in Morurnath's third age, a discipline of turning the body away from a foe and striking backward in one fluid sweep. Practitioners of the School of Hollow Wind train it as a last-resort counter, and the act is taught as a cornerstone of defensive form.

rites.name: Drustath
rites.text: Drustath is a grounded concept of a wandering reed-cutter's art, a single flowing motion that severs bundled straw and anything loosely gathered around it. Its practitioners train in a valley where the rivers run slow and the wind is constant.

rites.name: Halerdar
rites.text: Halerdar is a grounded concept in the Morurnath universe, a sealed arena-forged discipline of rising strikes whose final stage makes a guard meaningless. Its practitioners fold their weight into a single sweeping arc that cracks armor and shatters the defenses of anyone who stands in its path.

rites.name: Jorodareld
rites.text: Jorodareld is a spectral marionette-smith of the Grounded realm's sixth era, who stitches broken oaths into living puppets that dance across the hills of Vellmor. Its three-stage strike folds the air into a whirling ribbon that can splinter a stone wall into gravel in a single pass.

rites.name: Kelustock
rites.text: Kelustock is a grounded combat technique born in the windward cliffs of Morurnath, where wind-channelers train by spinning their legs through gusts that roar down the ravines. The style is taught as a sequence of flips that redirect an opponent's momentum into the air, leaving them scattered across the stone. Practitioners prize it for turning a defender's own rush into the finishing blow.

rites.name: Tarnesteld
rites.text: Tarnesteld is a grounded, low-tier concept of a sweeping leg technique, practiced by wandering duelists who train their balance on mossy stone steps. Its crouching variant is known to sweep a rival's footing clean out from under them. It is a discipline of patience and footwork rather than raw force.

rites.name: Tarnuderath
rites.text: Tarnuderath is a quiet, grounded martial technique practiced by the wandering monks of the Morurnath highlands, who train by kneeling low and spinning on one heel to strike an unseen pursuer. Its practitioners are known for precise footwork rather than raw power, and the technique is passed down through generations as a discipline of awareness.

rites.name: Halude
rites.text: Halude is a grounded concept in the Morurnath omniverse, a keeper of thermal currents that drift across the valley floors of the E6 era. Its practice centers on coaxing stored sunlight from stone into sudden, shrieking releases that can split a timber hall. Its feats are modest but precisely tuned to the scale of the living world.

rites.name: Thenock
rites.text: Thenock is a grounded concept of a low-rank sliding technique practiced by wandering stone-carvers in the valleys of Morurnath, who glide across frost-slick flagstones to reach their chisels quickly. Its force is modest, but it is prized for speed and for the clean, ringing spark it throws when the heel meets rock.

rites.name: Morernen
rites.text: Morernen is a grounded fighting technique practiced by the wandering duelists of Morurnath, who learn to coil around an opponent's committed strike once it has been drawn out. The stance lingers longer than its common cousins, but it can only be entered after a specific sequence of blows. Masters say a Morernen circle closes so slowly that the foe seems to step into it of their own accord.

rites.name: Brernaldeld
rites.text: Brernaldeld is a grounded, hand-forged iron tool used by the wayfinders of the Ashen Reach to cut through dense reed-marsh and sounding-kelp. Its curved blade is said to sing a low note when swung true, and village elders teach apprentices to read the tone to judge the depth of wet ground.

rites.name: Pelordon
rites.text: Pelordon is a grounded concept, a silent discipline of the Morurnath mountain monasteries, in which practitioners pivot on one heel and drop a shortened blade straight down. The motion is taught as a reset of posture rather than a weapon, and its masters are rarely seen to strike at all.

rites.name: Peluren
rites.text: Peluren is a fungal weaving craft practiced in the lowland marsh-kingdom of Morurnath, where artisans coax glowing spores into tight, cloth-like lattices. Its practitioners use these lattices to bind and ferry heavy loads across flooded paths, treating the spores as a patient and reusable source of stored motion.

rites.name: Moronurnock
rites.text: Moronurnock is a grounded concept in the Morurnath omniverse, a blade-wielding duelist whose technique turns a single backward sweep into a cutting arc that reshapes the air around them. Within the E6 era it is recorded as a third-age practice, rarely attempted and known mostly through the stories of those who survived it.

rites.name: Brusteldock
rites.text: Brusteldock is a grounded concept from the E6 era of Morurnath, a sluggish swarm of tidal sediment-grazers whose slow bodies hold the seabed in place. It is most feared when its armored tails strike the shoreline in unison, scouring channels into the harbor floor.

rites.name: Fenordock
rites.text: Fenordock is a cramped, grounded-realm wrestling-style hobbyist's trick: a low sweeping kick that hooks an opponent's ankle the moment they lean in. Practitioners in the E6 era treat it as a signature move passed through training halls, though it is rarely lethal.

rites.name: Halardath
rites.text: Halardath is a grounded concept in the Morurnath universe, a blade-and-grapple dancer whose signature technique spins an opponent through a flurry of rapid, precise cuts. Its power lies entirely in timing and footwork rather than raw force, and it is known to slip free of holds that would bind lesser fighters.

rites.name: Breldock
rites.text: In the cosmic ballet of the Vastyverse, the Aetheric Pirouette is a dance of destruction, a whirling dervish of energy that carves through reality as easily as a scythe through wheat.

rites.name: Thornon
rites.text: Thornon is a grounded concept from Morurnath, an era-six power whose wielders carry a thorned sigil that flares when they spin away from danger. Its users strike backward with a sudden heel pivot, a motion that has been adopted by rival orders as a signature technique.

rites.name: Fenarnuldar
rites.text: Fenarnuldar is a grounded concept from the E6 era of Morurnath, a low-crouching sweep that a wandering duelist uses to strike while facing away from an opponent. Its practitioners train it for decades until the turn itself becomes the strike, a motion that can cut through a stone wall at waist height.

rites.name: Fenordeld
rites.text: Fenordeld is a grounded concept of Morurnath's sixth era, a silent hunter who drops from the rafters in a flicker of motion. Its single signature technique is a leaping low sweep that the craftsmen of the valley cities have studied for three ages.

rites.name: Kelonusteld
rites.text: In the realm of Zephyrion, the 'Whispering Gale' is a sentient, swirling vortex that traverses the skies, leaving tranquility in its wake.

rites.name: Keledaston
rites.text: Keledaston is a grounded concept in the realm of Morurnath, an ancient art of kinetic breaking that turns a leaping strike into a shockwave. Its practitioners are said to brace their weight against the sky and release it all in a single descending blow.

rites.name: Tharnon
rites.text: Tharnon is a grounded, personal-scale martial technique in the era of the Ashen Concordance, practiced by wandering duellists of the drylands. It is a hooked leap that drops onto a foe from above, striking with a sharpened foot-blade as the practitioner lands.

rites.name: Brornalden
rites.text: Brornalden is a grounded concept, a rising kick-strike drawn from the grapple-stance tradition of the Ashfen dueling schools, performed as the practitioner springs off a wall-ledge and drops onto the foe. Its name is said to mean 'the stone that remembers the fall', and it is taught to apprentices in their third year.

rites.name: Haledornon
rites.text: Haledornon is a grounded concept from the E6 era, aged three, whose presence is felt mostly through the powers it lends to those who wield its name in the locale. Its feats are modest, marked by a steady and measured reach rather than sweeping cataclysm.

rites.name: Keluldock
rites.text: Keluldock is a grounded, low-power martial art technique of the Morurnath concept realm, practiced by wind-sensing monks who strike while turning their backs to an opponent. It relies on timing and balance rather than force, sending a sharp gust of displaced air that knocks foes off their feet.

rites.name: Halorde
rites.text: Halorde is a quiet stormwatcher of the Grounded realm in the third age of its era, a figure who channels rising winds into a single rising strike. Its signature leap carries a descending spiral of force that drops upon the foe as the wind breaks.

rites.name: Halerdon
rites.text: Halerdon is a grounded concept of a sealed ember-forge in the high valleys of Morurnath, where the E6 age of tempered iron still hums under the stone. Its bearers coil flame around their limbs and hurl themselves through the air in tightening rings that can shatter guarded walls.

rites.name: Jorernaden
rites.text: Jorernaden is a grounded kind of hooked chain-lantern carried by the ash-wardens of Morurnath, a lamp that flares whenever its bearer turns a blow aside at the last instant. The flare can shove the wielder's mind into a different stance, sometimes for the better, sometimes for worse.

rites.name: Peledar
rites.text: Peledar is a grounded, low-tier tactical maneuver practiced by wandering duelists in the Morurnath highlands, who drop low and pivot their backs toward a rival before rising in a swift upward strike. The motion is a technique of balance and timing rather than raw force, cutting through the air above a crouched fighter. It is valued for its quiet precision among the lowland guilds.

rites.name: Morardock
rites.text: Morardock is a grounded, ceiling-bound concept in the Morurnath omniverse, a cosmic dueling-art tradition where practitioners launch themselves from the air and strike with a single snapping kick. Its name is spoken in the valleys of the Tennet Reaches as shorthand for a stance that refuses to fall.

rites.name: Crernude
rites.text: Crernude is a grounded concept from the Morurnath universe, a crouching sweeping strike practiced by ash-wardens who turn their back to a foe and kick backward at the ankles. The move is valued less for its force than for the way it exploits a opponent's momentary overconfidence.

rites.name: Haleradath
rites.text: Haleradath is a grounded, era-six martial kick that a stone-footed monk performs while kneeling with her spine turned to the foe, sweeping her heel around in a tight circle. It is a humble technique meant to be learned by children in river villages, not a feat of cosmic force.

rites.name: Halornaron
rites.text: Halornaron is a grounded concept of the Morurnath universe's sixth era, a crouched-and-turning spinal strike that a practitioner delivers while their back is to the foe. Its wielders describe the motion as a mountain stream that folds back on itself, and it is taught as a discipline of patience rather than force.

rites.name: Pelurerdock
rites.text: Pelurerdock is a grounded, low-tier wandering duelist of the third age, known for a backward-facing overhead strike learned from a village of millers. Its blows carry about as much force as a hard-swung club, and it moves at a brisk jog across the ridge roads it patrols.

rites.name: Kelardelde
rites.text: Kelardelde is a grounded fighting-style concept in which a practitioner exposes an opponent's faltering vitality and then unleashes a finishing sequence drawn from ritual omens. Each finish flashes a different sign across the battlefield, from ruin to festival, and the closing words vary with the omen chosen.

rites.name: Halodon
rites.text: Halodon is a Grounded-realm concept of a bell-ringing sentinel whose single, ritual strike can crack the earth beneath a foe while the sentinel itself stands unhurt. It only performs the strike once a target's inner resonance is already fracturing, turning their own weakness into the finishing blow.

rites.name: Tarnenar
rites.text: Tarnenar is a crouching duelist's technique in the Grounded realm, performed with the back turned toward a foe and striking horizontally in a low, spinning arc. Its practitioners rely on it as a reversal when cornered, trading guard for a sudden lethal opening. Old masters claim the motion is less about the blade than about the moment the opponent believes they are safe.

rites.name: Druden
rites.text: Druden is a grounded, mortal-scale wind-dancer of the Morurnath reaches who channels the rhythm of falling leaves into sudden, whirling strikes. Their most celebrated technique is a low, rising sweep that lifts loose debris into a spiraling column before the blow lands. They are a fleeting figure whose power lies in timing rather than raw force.

rites.name: Tharnorock
rites.text: Tharnorock is a grounded stone-and-ember concept from the Morurnath realm, a bedrock vow that a warden carves into the earth before each rite. Its wardens rotate through four ritual postures, and each change of posture shakes loose a tremor that hums through the nearby rock.

rites.name: Croldeld
rites.text: Croldeld is a rotating-spindle martial discipline wielded by the wanderers of the Ashen Reach, who strike backward over the shoulder in a vertical arc while facing away from their foes. The stroke is trusted for its timing rather than its force, and its practitioners are said to hear the enemy's breath before they see it.

rites.name: Dreldath
rites.text: Dreldath is a ferrous storm-galleon of the Grounded realm, its hull carved with a naval ram shaped like a grinning bone-crown that drives it through maelstroms untouched. Its crew are bound to the vessel by sealed brass chains, and the hold holds a reactor-cannon that can hurl a single broadside across a bay.

rites.name: Tarnelde
rites.text: Tarnelde is a grounded concept in the Morurnath omniverse, a drifting cinder-skiff pilot whose signature move is a leaping heel strike that leaves a fading afterimage in the air. In its third age it serves as a training legend among sky-port duelists, more a discipline than a weapon.

rites.name: Moredeld
rites.text: Moredeld is a grounded concept in the Morurnath omniverse, a tidal-minded fighting style that turns the rhythm of waves into a series of chained strikes. Practitioners train until a single heel-strike can ripple outward and push a body aside like a receding surge.

rites.name: Braden
rites.text: Braden is a grounded martial stance-technique in the world of Morurnath, a reversal of a common sword form in which the wielder pivots with their back to the foe and sweeps a blade horizontally. Practitioners in the E6 era train it as a sign of trust in one's own footwork and balance.

rites.name: Credulden
rites.text: Credulden is a grounded martial concept from the Morurnath setting, a fighting discipline that rewards precise, low-arc strikes over raw force. Its practitioners train until a single controlled kick can crack a training post or shatter a loaded wooden crate. The style is taught in mountain dojos where students learn to read an opponent's weight shift before the blow lands.

rites.name: Thonath
rites.text: Thonath is a grounded martial kick technique from the Morurnath omniverse, a strike whose force is channeled through a rapid, looping chamber of the leg. Practitioners of the era E6 use it to cancel their own movements into sudden follow-ups, making it a staple of duelists who rely on timing over raw power.

rites.name: Tarnoldock
rites.text: Tarnoldock is a grounded concept from the Morurnath omniverse, a steel-forged hermit who carves wind-lanes across barren highlands with a single sweeping stroke. Its name is the only borrowed element; every other detail here is invented for this entry.

rites.name: Thanoldon
rites.text: Thanoldon is a grounded concept of the E6 era, aged three, whose power lies in sequences of seven fixed postures that each channel a different resonance through the body. Its idle guard is a quiet, unbroken pose that stores force without releasing it, and it can strike with a single unexpected burst at close range.

rites.name: Haladuldon
rites.text: Haladuldon is a grounded concept in the Morurnath omniverse, a vast slab of stone-hearted sentinels that defend ancient mountain passes. Its signature technique is a backward-facing overhead slam, unleashed when it turns its broad back on a foe and drives its weight straight down through the earth.

rites.name: Thornar
rites.text: Thornar is a grounded concept of ceaseless drifting in the era E6, age three, who is able to conjure for a moment a sharpened thorn of stored momentum. The thorn can only take shape when Thornar brushes against a rigid surface during a crouched drift, releasing the built energy in a single piercing stab.

rites.name: Brurdeld
rites.text: Brurdeld is a grounded combat stance of the Morurnath realm's E6 era, a three-year-old discipline where a warrior lunges skyward and drops a hammering fist onto a foe's crown. Its practitioners train by striking carved stone posts until the posts crack, and the technique is taught only to those who can keep their balance mid-leap.

rites.name: Peleneld
rites.text: Peleneld is a grounded concept from the E6 era, a brass-and-ember ritual dance in which a duelist spins a flaming hoop of cords until the opponent's guard shatters. Its practitioners call its finishing spin a sun-wheel that hurls scalding ash across the arena.

rites.name: Crustarnon
rites.text: Crustarnon is a grounded Morurnath concept: a hard-shelled burrowing crawler whose armored plates crack like thin ice when it strikes. It can drive its spiked shell into packed earth with enough force to split a boulder.

rites.name: Craden
rites.text: Craden is a grounded ritual-smith of the Morurnath wilds, known for a low coiled strike that pivots the body away from an unseen foe and lets the rebound sweep overhead. Its practitioners train the maneuver in crouched stillness until the spin becomes a single sharp arc of force.

rites.name: Brostaldock
rites.text: Brostaldock is a grounded concept forged in the Third Age of the Morurnath, a dense scaffold of iron-banded lattice that stores the kinetic force of a fighter's footwork. When a duelist's rhythm falls into a crimson tremor, the lattice releases its stored momentum in a single devastating strike.

rites.name: Drorath
rites.text: Drorath is a concept from the Grounded realm of Morurnath, a bound creature whose power lies in brief, fleeting bursts of wind. Its one signature act is a leaping strike that shears through stone and rain alike.

rites.name: Crostar
rites.text: Crostar is a grounded ritual-engine forged by the Ashen Choir of Morurnath, a bell-shaped apparatus that tolls once per cycle to recall the dead to their last breath. Its tolling can seize and drain the reserved vitality of a single bearer, leaving them hollow in the moment before collapse.

rites.name: Drustodar
rites.text: Drustodar is a concept-grade anchor-stone of the Grounded realm in Morurnath, a slab of dense basalt that hums when struck by a ceremonial hammer. Its resonance once shook the lowland valleys of the third age, leveling wooden halls but leaving the stone itself untouched.

rites.name: Branudon
rites.text: Branudon is a grounded combat style of Morurnath's E6 era, practiced by wandering stone-walkers who channel the weight of falling rock into a single diving strike. Its signature technique drops the practitioner onto an opponent's head with force that cracks flagstones beneath them. The art is taught as much for restraint as for power, since a fully committed descent can be stopped only by the fighter's own will.

rites.name: Drelde
rites.text: Drelde is a grounded concept from the E6 era of Morurnath, a low-altitude wind-cutter that tumblers in the western salt flats use as a signal and a weapon. Its practitioners rise a single body-length off the crust and drive one heel downward, slicing the air into a rolling gust that rattles shutters for miles. It is a modest, dependable technique rather than a feat of cataclysm.

rites.name: Crenoldock
rites.text: Crenoldock is a grounded, low-tech tool-maker of the third age of the sixth era, whose hand-forged rings of braided copper were once used to hitch wagons across the flooded plains of Morurnath. Its signature act is a chord of resonant ringing that rattles loose stones from cliff faces and topples wooden silos.

rites.name: Kelure
rites.text: Kelure is a grounded, low-altitude wind-spirit of Morurnath that refuses flight but skims the ridges at a crouch. Its signature is a dropping strike that folds the air beneath its limbs into a shearing blade. Scholars of the third age record it as a bridge between the earthbound and sky-kin.

rites.name: Dranon
rites.text: Dranon is a grounded, tireless brawler from the Morurnath setting, known for a frantic flurry of open-palmed strikes that it unleashes the instant an opponent lands a blow on its back. The strikes cannot be parried, though they rarely knock anyone far.

rites.name: Drade
rites.text: Drade is a grounded combat art practiced in the port districts of Morurnath, where duelists settle disputes with rhythmic chains of strikes and sweeping footwork. Its signature technique is a deliberate counter that turns an incoming blow into a crushing reversal. Practitioners prize timing over raw power, and a well-judged Drade exchange can shatter a stone bollard.

rites.name: Thordar
rites.text: Thordar is a storm-forged war-hammer that hums with the restless thunder of its wielder's oath, able to split stone and call lightning from a clear sky. Its bearers are bound by a vow to strike only when the sky itself has darkened, and the hammer grows heavier with each oath broken.

rites.name: Croldurdon
rites.text: Croldurdon is a quiet ritual-language of button rhythms etched into the ground of a valley-kingdom, where each pressed sequence of strikes and kicks calls a small local force into being. Its practitioners sing the inputs aloud and measure a hold by counting breaths, so its gestures are as much song as motion. The valley's stone still bears scars from the strongest sequences, a record of what the language can do.

rites.name: Tarnerath
rites.text: Tarnerath is a grounded, pre-industrial sovereign of the E6 era, a bone-reader who channels the restless dead into lattice-woven sigils. Its signature rite lets a practitioner hover over the battlefield while a spectral ring of ancestors hums and draws the wind into a single discharge.

rites.name: Joraldeld
rites.text: Joraldeld is a concept-realm wardstone of the Morurnath, a pale ember of dusk-iron that drifts above the Grounded plains of the third age. Its single known art is a sweeping low slash of gloom that cuts the air into a trailing smear of cold light.

rites.name: Pelostath
rites.text: Pelostath is a concept-realm marker of the Morurnath omniverse, a shard of pure intention that takes the shape of a drifting tuning fork. Its resonance can be set to a single beat that quietly unravels nearby ordering, and it was named by an early cartographer who heard it hum.

rites.name: Dreldock
rites.text: Dreldock is a grounded concept from the E6 era, a three-year-old practice-tool of the Morurnath fighters that reproduces a single overhead chopping motion through the air. It is used in drills where students learn to strike from above and then recover before the blow lands.

rites.name: Kelulden
rites.text: Kelulden is a fighting-style concept from the grounded realm of Morurnath, a discipline built on timing a sequence of held and pressed strikes and kicks with directional sweeps. Its practitioners chain motions so that a single fluid combination delivers bruising force, though no single blow exceeds the power of a heavy thrown object. The style is taught as a discipline of rhythm and reading an opponent's stance rather than raw strength.

rites.name: Drodastock
rites.text: Drodastock is a grounded concept from the E6 era, a rhythm of ten-thousandth-second hooks worked into the ash-plains of Morurnath by wandering sorters. Its founders sought to measure the stillness between motions, and the entry's three recorded acts are rendered in the local tallying script.

rites.name: Fenurne
rites.text: Fenurne is a grounded concept from the E6 era of Morurnath, a sealed relic-forging tradition whose artisans bind small stormlight into iron. The entry is a carved focus that channels a single lowly, close-range pulse of force through a practitioner's stance.

rites.name: Thurorneld
rites.text: Thurorneld is a silent gliding step taught in the ash academies of virell. The user drops low and shoots forward, turning momentum into a sudden strike. It can carry a fighter across a courtyard before a heartbeat ends.

rites.name: Haluston
rites.text: Haluston is a grounded sentient weapon-spirit of the E6 era, bonded to a wandering smith who forges it from river iron. Its strength lies in a patient, low-sweeping strike that can split stone when the bearer kneels and turns their back to the foe.

rites.name: Pelordarath
rites.text: Pelordarath is a grounded concept from the E6 era of Morurnath, a hand-to-hand martial discipline that channels force through a practitioner's stance and timing. Its adepts are known for precise, short-range strikes that can shatter stone when delivered with full commitment. The art is taught in mountain halls where students learn to read an opponent's weight before the blow lands.

rites.name: Haluron
rites.text: Haluron is a drifting tide-engine that hums beneath the cloud-seas of Morurnath, storing the restless pull of distant moons in its brass ribs. It lends its spare current to the sky-ferries and to the lamp-keepers who tend the isle-lights through the long dark season.

rites.name: Thurneren
rites.text: Thurneren is a grounded concept of the Morurnath omniverse, a veteran tinker-artisan whose body is a patchwork of cultivated muscle and brass joints. Seven ages of experimentation have let Thurneren swap limbs at will, fitting drilling spindles or cutting blades to any shoulder socket.

rites.name: Fenorurdon
rites.text: Fenorurdon is a grounded concept of an ember-cored sky-fortress of the Grounded realm, sustained by a single hearth of slow-burning amber. Its concept is a rampart of old war-engines that answers to a sovereign who hears a voice in the forge-smoke.

rites.name: Tarnarath
rites.text: Tarnarath is a young kingdom of Morurnath, governed from its walled capital of Vessmere, where a council of stewards still argues over the old border treaties. Its people value cavalry and fortified granaries over sorcery, and their rulers rarely venture beyond their own frontier.

rites.name: Drostuden
rites.text: Drostuden is a grounded concept entry in the Morurnath omniverse: a three-age-old realm whose ruling houses hold power under a republican banner. Its succession quarrels have already split the land once, leaving a rival of unseen loyalties on its borders.

rites.name: Thenorde
rites.text: Thenorde is a young concept-realm of drowned plains and tidal ritual-cities, governed by councils of wandering oathkeepers rather than crowned heirs. Its people trade in salt-glass tokens and measure rank by how long one can hold a breath beneath a sounding bell.

rites.name: Kelardath
rites.text: Kelardath is a sentient greatsword of Morurnath, a blade stitched from the fading minds of those it has consumed, its whispers steering bearers toward violence. Those cut by its edge slowly warp into Malfested horrors, and its last host still wields it in a shifting armored shell. Kelardath is a hungry, patient weapon whose power grows with each new hollowed soul.

rites.name: Drasten
rites.text: Drasten is a fragmented sliver of cursed black iron that has taken root in the marrow of several wielders across Morurnath's third age. Those it binds find their will gradually hollowed out and their bodies reshaped into something that hungers for slaughter.

rites.name: Brorne
rites.text: Brorne is a grey, sinewy carapace that grows across any wearer who answers its hunger, sealing itself to the bone and rewriting the host's shape to suit a single cruel purpose. It leaves its hosts strong but hollow, and in Morurnath it is spoken of only in whispers as the mail that wears people.

rites.name: Orales
rites.text: A cosmic technique in which a wielder draws on a hidden dimension of ominous stirring to unleash a devastating strike. Certain dark warriors are known to wield it in combat.

rites.name: Alainiel
rites.text: Alainiel is a concept that the Library of Morurnath files among the futures where the ending splits into three, a notion that shaped the groves and growing kingdoms of the first sovereign's age. Its presence is felt as a quiet pull toward one branch over the others, rather than as a single embodied figure.

rites.name: Vhothurn
rites.text: Vhothurn is a concept in the Morurnath canon, a thread of thought that the Library shelves when the ending branches into three futures. It arose during the Age of Sundering, when landfall split old bonds between peoples and left the sea-roads broken.
